summary: Self-supervised pre-training has revolutionized foundation models for languages, individual 2D images and videos, but remains largely unexplored for learning 3D-aware representations from multi-view images. In this paper, we present E-RayZer, a self-supervised large 3D Vision model that learns truly 3D-aware representations directly from unlabeled images. Unlike prior self-supervised methods such as RayZer that infer 3D indirectly through latent-space view synthesis, E-RayZer operates directly in 3D space, performing self-supervised 3D reconstruction with Explicit geometry. This formulation eliminates shortcut solutions and yields representations that are geometrically grounded. To ensure convergence and scalability, we introduce a novel fine-grained learning curriculum that organizes training from easy to hard samples and harmonizes heterogeneous data sources in an entirely unsupervised manner. Experiments demonstrate that E-RayZer significantly outperforms RayZer on pose estimation, matches or sometimes surpasses fully supervised reconstruction models such as VGGT. Furthermore, its learned representations outperform leading visual pre-training models (e.g., DINOv3, CroCo v2, VideoMAE V2, and RayZer) when transferring to 3D downstream tasks, establishing E-RayZer as a new paradigm for 3D-aware visual pre-training.

title: Hierarchical Dataset Selection for High-Quality Data Sharing
summary: The success of modern machine learning hinges on access to high-quality training data. In many real-world scenarios, such as acquiring data from public repositories or sharing across institutions, data is naturally organized into discrete datasets that vary in relevance, quality, and utility. Selecting which repositories or institutions to search for useful datasets, and which datasets to incorporate into model training are therefore critical decisions, yet most existing methods select individual samples and treat all data as equally relevant, ignoring differences between datasets and their sources. In this work, we formalize the task of dataset selection: selecting entire datasets from a large, heterogeneous pool to improve downstream performance under resource constraints. We propose Dataset Selection via Hierarchies (DaSH), a dataset selection method that models utility at both dataset and group (e.g., collections, institutions) levels, enabling efficient generalization from limited observations. Across two public benchmarks (Digit-Five and DomainNet), DaSH outperforms state-of-the-art data selection baselines by up to 26.2% in accuracy, while requiring significantly fewer exploration steps. Ablations show DaSH is robust to low-resource settings and lack of relevant datasets, making it suitable for scalable and adaptive dataset selection in practical multi-source learning workflows.

title: Bidirectional Normalizing Flow: From Data to Noise and Back
summary: Normalizing Flows (NFs) have been established as a principled framework for generative modeling. Standard NFs consist of a forward process and a reverse process: the forward process maps data to noise, while the reverse process generates samples by inverting it. Typical NF forward transformations are constrained by explicit invertibility, ensuring that the reverse process can serve as their exact analytic inverse. Recent developments in TARFlow and its variants have revitalized NF methods by combining Transformers and autoregressive flows, but have also exposed causal decoding as a major bottleneck. In this work, we introduce Bidirectional Normalizing Flow ($\textbf{BiFlow}$), a framework that removes the need for an exact analytic inverse. BiFlow learns a reverse model that approximates the underlying noise-to-data inverse mapping, enabling more flexible loss functions and architectures. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate that BiFlow, compared to its causal decoding counterpart, improves generation quality while accelerating sampling by up to two orders of magnitude. BiFlow yields state-of-the-art results among NF-based methods and competitive performance among single-evaluation ("1-NFE") methods. Following recent encouraging progress on NFs, we hope our work will draw further attention to this classical paradigm.

title: Group Diffusion: Enhancing Image Generation by Unlocking Cross-Sample Collaboration
summary: In this work, we explore an untapped signal in diffusion model inference. While all previous methods generate images independently at inference, we instead ask if samples can be generated collaboratively. We propose Group Diffusion, unlocking the attention mechanism to be shared across images, rather than limited to just the patches within an image. This enables images to be jointly denoised at inference time, learning both intra and inter-image correspondence. We observe a clear scaling effect - larger group sizes yield stronger cross-sample attention and better generation quality. Furthermore, we introduce a qualitative measure to capture this behavior and show that its strength closely correlates with FID. Built on standard diffusion transformers, our GroupDiff achieves up to 32.2% FID improvement on ImageNet-256x256. Our work reveals cross-sample inference as an effective, previously unexplored mechanism for generative modeling.

title: Omni-Attribute: Open-vocabulary Attribute Encoder for Visual Concept Personalization
summary: Visual concept personalization aims to transfer only specific image attributes, such as identity, expression, lighting, and style, into unseen contexts. However, existing methods rely on holistic embeddings from general-purpose image encoders, which entangle multiple visual factors and make it difficult to isolate a single attribute. This often leads to information leakage and incoherent synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce Omni-Attribute, the first open-vocabulary image attribute encoder designed to learn high-fidelity, attribute-specific representations. Our approach jointly designs the data and model: (i) we curate semantically linked image pairs annotated with positive and negative attributes to explicitly teach the encoder what to preserve or suppress; and (ii) we adopt a dual-objective training paradigm that balances generative fidelity with contrastive disentanglement. The resulting embeddings prove effective for open-vocabulary attribute retrieval, personalization, and compositional generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks.

title: Empowering Dynamic Urban Navigation with Stereo and Mid-Level Vision
summary:
The success of foundation models in language and vision motivated research in fully end-to-end robot navigation foundation models (NFMs). NFMs directly map monocular visual input to control actions and ignore mid-level vision modules (tracking, depth estimation, etc) entirely. While the assumption that vision capabilities will emerge implicitly is compelling, it requires large amounts of pixel-to-action supervision that are difficult to obtain. The challenge is especially pronounced in dynamic and unstructured settings, where robust navigation requires precise geometric and dynamic understanding, while the depth-scale ambiguity in monocular views further limits accurate spatial reasoning. In this paper, we show that relying on monocular vision and ignoring mid-level vision priors is inefficient.
  We present StereoWalker, which augments NFMs with stereo inputs and explicit mid-level vision such as depth estimation and dense pixel tracking. Our intuition is straightforward: stereo inputs resolve the depth-scale ambiguity, and modern mid-level vision models provide reliable geometric and motion structure in dynamic scenes. We also curate a large stereo navigation dataset with automatic action annotation from Internet stereo videos to support training of StereoWalker and to facilitate future research. Through our experiments, we find that mid-level vision enables StereoWalker to achieve a comparable performance as the state-of-the-art using only 1.5% of the training data, and surpasses the state-of-the-art using the full data. We also observe that stereo vision yields higher navigation performance than monocular input.

AI.title_translation: 利用立体视觉和中级视觉赋能动态城市导航
AI.tldr: 现有的导航基础模型（NFM）效率低下且需要大量数据。本文提出StereoWalker，结合立体视觉输入和显式中级视觉模块（深度、跟踪），解决了深度尺度模糊性，并在动态城市导航中以极少的数据量实现了超越现有技术（SOTA）的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端导航基础模型（NFM）依赖单目视觉，忽略中级视觉模块，需要难以获取的大量像素到动作的监督数据。在动态和非结构化环境中，单目视觉的深度尺度模糊性限制了精确的空间推理，难以实现鲁棒导航。
AI.method: 提出StereoWalker模型，它通过立体视觉输入和显式的中级视觉模块（如深度估计和密集像素跟踪）来增强导航基础模型（NFM）。立体输入用于解决深度尺度模糊性，中级视觉用于提供可靠的几何和运动结构。同时，还策划了一个包含自动动作标注的大型立体导航数据集。
AI.result: 实验发现，使用仅1.5%的训练数据，StereoWalker通过中级视觉实现了与现有技术（SOTA）相当的性能；使用全部数据时，则超越了SOTA。此外，立体视觉比单目输入带来了更高的导航性能。
AI.conclusion: 依赖单目视觉并忽略中级视觉先验是低效的。通过立体输入和显式中级视觉增强导航基础模型（NFM）可以显著提高数据效率和导航性能。
AI.translation:
基础模型在语言和视觉领域的成功推动了全端到端机器人导航基础模型（NFMs）的研究。NFMs直接将单目视觉输入映射到控制动作，完全忽略了中级视觉模块（跟踪、深度估计等）。虽然视觉能力将隐式出现的假设很有吸引力，但这需要难以获取的大量像素到动作的监督。在动态和非结构化环境中，这一挑战尤为突出，因为鲁棒导航需要精确的几何和动态理解，而单目视图中的深度尺度模糊性进一步限制了准确的空间推理。在本文中，我们证明了依赖单目视觉并忽略中级视觉先验是低效的。
我们提出了StereoWalker，它利用立体输入和显式的中级视觉（如深度估计和密集像素跟踪）来增强NFM。我们的直觉很简单：立体输入解决了深度尺度模糊性，而现代中级视觉模型在动态场景中提供了可靠的几何和运动结构。我们还利用互联网立体视频中的自动动作标注，策划了一个大型立体导航数据集，以支持StereoWalker的训练并促进未来的研究。通过实验，我们发现中级视觉使StereoWalker仅使用1.5%的训练数据就能达到与现有技术相当的性能，并在使用全部数据时超越了现有技术。我们还观察到立体视觉比单目输入产生了更高的导航性能。
AI.summary: 针对现有端到端导航基础模型（NFM）依赖单目视觉、数据需求量大且在动态环境中空间推理能力不足的问题，本文提出了StereoWalker。该模型通过结合立体视觉输入和显式中级视觉模块（如深度和跟踪），解决了深度尺度模糊性，并提供了可靠的几何和运动结构。研究表明，StereoWalker仅用1.5%的训练数据即可达到现有技术的性能，使用全部数据时则实现超越，证明了立体视觉和中级视觉先验在动态城市导航中的高效性和优越性。
AI.keywords: 立体视觉, 中级视觉, 导航基础模型, 动态城市导航, 深度估计
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于，它挑战了机器人领域（尤其是导航）中纯粹的端到端基础模型范式。通过重新引入立体视觉和显式的中级视觉先验（如深度和跟踪），StereoWalker极大地提高了模型的训练效率和数据利用率。其核心价值在于证明了在需要高精度几何和动态理解的动态城市环境中，结构化的、可解释的中间表示（中级视觉）并非冗余，而是实现鲁棒性、高效性的关键，这为未来高效的导航基础模型设计提供了新的方向。

title: SceneMaker: Open-set 3D Scene Generation with Decoupled De-occlusion and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We propose a decoupled 3D scene generation framework called SceneMaker in this work. Due to the lack of sufficient open-set de-occlusion and pose estimation priors, existing methods struggle to simultaneously produce high-quality geometry and accurate poses under severe occlusion and open-set settings. To address these issues, we first decouple the de-occlusion model from 3D object generation, and enhance it by leveraging image datasets and collected de-occlusion datasets for much more diverse open-set occlusion patterns. Then, we propose a unified pose estimation model that integrates global and local mechanisms for both self-attention and cross-attention to improve accuracy. Besides, we construct an open-set 3D scene dataset to further extend the generalization of the pose estimation model. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our decoupled framework on both indoor and open-set scenes. Our codes and datasets is released at https://idea-research.github.io/SceneMaker/.

AI.title_translation: SceneMaker：采用解耦去遮挡和姿态估计模型的开放集3D场景生成
AI.tldr: SceneMaker 是一个解耦的3D场景生成框架，它通过将去遮挡模型与3D对象生成解耦，并引入一个结合全局和局部机制的统一姿态估计模型，显著提高了在严重遮挡和开放集设置下的几何质量和姿态精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法缺乏足够的开放集去遮挡和姿态估计先验知识，因此难以在严重遮挡和开放集设置下同时生成高质量的几何结构和准确的姿态。
AI.method: 提出一个名为 SceneMaker 的解耦3D场景生成框架。首先，将去遮挡模型与3D对象生成解耦，并利用图像和收集的去遮挡数据集来处理多样化的开放集遮挡模式。其次，提出了一个统一的姿态估计模型，该模型集成了全局和局部机制用于自注意力和交叉注意力，以提高精度。此外，还构建了一个开放集3D场景数据集来增强姿态估计模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: 综合实验证明，该解耦框架在室内和开放集场景中都表现出优越性。
AI.translation: 我们在这项工作中提出了一个名为 SceneMaker 的解耦3D场景生成框架。由于缺乏足够的开放集去遮挡和姿态估计先验知识，现有方法难以在严重遮挡和开放集设置下同时生成高质量的几何结构和准确的姿态。为解决这些问题，我们首先将去遮挡模型与3D对象生成解耦，并通过利用图像数据集和收集的去遮挡数据集来增强它，以处理更多样化的开放集遮挡模式。随后，我们提出了一个统一的姿态估计模型，该模型集成了全局和局部机制用于自注意力和交叉注意力，以提高精度。此外，我们构建了一个开放集3D场景数据集，以进一步扩展姿态估计模型的泛化能力。综合实验证明了我们提出的解耦框架在室内和开放集场景中的优越性。我们的代码和数据集已发布在 https://idea-research.github.io/SceneMaker/。
AI.summary: SceneMaker 是一种新的解耦3D场景生成框架，旨在解决现有方法在开放集和严重遮挡环境下生成高质量几何和准确姿态的难题。核心创新在于将去遮挡模型与3D生成过程解耦，并利用多样化数据集进行增强；同时，设计了一个结合全局和局部注意力机制的统一姿态估计模型。此外，项目还构建了一个新的开放集3D场景数据集。实验结果验证了该解耦框架在不同场景中的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 3D场景生成, 解耦框架, 去遮挡, 姿态估计, 开放集
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于其“解耦”策略，将复杂的3D场景生成任务分解为去遮挡和姿态估计两个独立且可强化的模块。这种解耦设计允许研究人员针对性地利用更丰富、更多样化的2D图像和专门收集的去遮挡数据集来训练去遮挡能力，从而显著提高了模型在开放集和严重遮挡情况下的鲁棒性。统一姿态估计模型结合全局和局部机制，是提升3D场景空间一致性和精度的关键。同时，构建新的开放集数据集对于推动该领域研究的泛化能力具有重要价值。

title: WorldLens: Full-Spectrum Evaluations of Driving World Models in Real World
comments: Preprint; 80 pages, 37 figures, 29 tables; Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/worldlens
summary: Generative world models are reshaping embodied AI, enabling agents to synthesize realistic 4D driving environments that look convincing but often fail physically or behaviorally. Despite rapid progress, the field still lacks a unified way to assess whether generated worlds preserve geometry, obey physics, or support reliable control. We introduce WorldLens, a full-spectrum benchmark evaluating how well a model builds, understands, and behaves within its generated world. It spans five aspects -- Generation, Reconstruction, Action-Following, Downstream Task, and Human Preference -- jointly covering visual realism, geometric consistency, physical plausibility, and functional reliability. Across these dimensions, no existing world model excels universally: those with strong textures often violate physics, while geometry-stable ones lack behavioral fidelity. To align objective metrics with human judgment, we further construct WorldLens-26K, a large-scale dataset of human-annotated videos with numerical scores and textual rationales, and develop WorldLens-Agent, an evaluation model distilled from these annotations to enable scalable, explainable scoring. Together, the benchmark, dataset, and agent form a unified ecosystem for measuring world fidelity -- standardizing how future models are judged not only by how real they look, but by how real they behave.
comment: Preprint; 80 pages, 37 figures, 29 tables; Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/worldlens

AI.title_translation: WorldLens：真实世界中驾驶世界模型的全谱评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了WorldLens，一个评估驾驶世界模型的全谱基准，涵盖视觉真实性、物理合理性和功能可靠性。它还包含一个人类标注数据集（WorldLens-26K）和一个可扩展的评估模型（WorldLens-Agent），旨在统一世界模型保真度的衡量标准。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式世界模型虽然视觉上逼真，但在物理或行为上经常失败。该领域缺乏一个统一的方法来评估生成的“世界”是否保持几何结构、遵守物理定律或支持可靠的控制。
AI.method: 引入了WorldLens，一个涵盖五个方面（生成、重建、动作遵循、下游任务和人类偏好）的全谱基准。构建了WorldLens-26K大规模人类标注数据集，包含数值分数和文本理由。开发了WorldLens-Agent，一个从标注中提取的、可扩展的评估模型。
AI.result: 现有世界模型无法在所有评估维度上普遍表现出色：纹理强大的模型往往违反物理定律，而几何稳定的模型则缺乏行为保真度。
AI.conclusion: WorldLens基准、数据集和评估模型共同形成了一个统一的生态系统，用于衡量“世界”保真度，规范了未来模型的评判标准，使其不仅取决于外观真实性，还取决于行为真实性。
AI.translation: 生成式世界模型正在重塑具身AI，使智能体能够合成逼真的4D驾驶环境，这些环境看起来令人信服，但往往在物理或行为上存在缺陷。尽管进展迅速，该领域仍然缺乏一种统一的方式来评估生成的“世界”是否保持几何结构、遵守物理定律或支持可靠的控制。我们引入了WorldLens，一个全谱基准，用于评估模型在其生成的“世界”中构建、理解和行为的表现。它涵盖了五个方面——生成、重建、动作遵循、下游任务和人类偏好——共同覆盖了视觉真实性、几何一致性、物理合理性和功能可靠性。在这些维度上，没有现有的世界模型能够普遍表现出色：那些纹理强大的模型往往违反物理定律，而几何稳定的模型则缺乏行为保真度。为了使客观指标与人类判断保持一致，我们进一步构建了WorldLens-26K，这是一个包含数值分数和文本理由的大规模人类标注视频数据集，并开发了WorldLens-Agent，一个从这些标注中提取的评估模型，以实现可扩展、可解释的评分。该基准、数据集和评估模型共同构成了一个衡量“世界”保真度的统一生态系统——规范了未来模型的评判标准，使其不仅取决于外观的真实性，还取决于行为的真实性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了WorldLens，一个用于全面评估驾驶世界模型的基准套件，旨在解决现有模型在物理和行为保真度上的不足。WorldLens包含五个评估维度，并附带WorldLens-26K人类标注数据集和WorldLens-Agent评估模型。研究发现，现有模型在视觉真实性和物理/行为可靠性之间存在权衡。WorldLens生态系统为未来世界模型的保真度评估提供了统一标准。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 驾驶环境, 全谱评估, 基准, 保真度
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于提出了一个全面的评估框架WorldLens，它将世界模型的评估从单纯的视觉真实性扩展到几何一致性、物理合理性和功能可靠性（如动作遵循和下游任务），解决了具身AI领域评估标准不统一的痛点。WorldLens-26K数据集和WorldLens-Agent评估模型的引入，使得评估过程可扩展且与人类判断对齐，对于推动驾驶世界模型向更可靠、更逼真的行为发展具有重要意义。

title: StereoSpace: Depth-Free Synthesis of Stereo Geometry via End-to-End Diffusion in a Canonical Space
summary: We introduce StereoSpace, a diffusion-based framework for monocular-to-stereo synthesis that models geometry purely through viewpoint conditioning, without explicit depth or warping. A canonical rectified space and the conditioning guide the generator to infer correspondences and fill disocclusions end-to-end. To ensure fair and leakage-free evaluation, we introduce an end-to-end protocol that excludes any ground truth or proxy geometry estimates at test time. The protocol emphasizes metrics reflecting downstream relevance: iSQoE for perceptual comfort and MEt3R for geometric consistency. StereoSpace surpasses other methods from the warp & inpaint, latent-warping, and warped-conditioning categories, achieving sharp parallax and strong robustness on layered and non-Lambertian scenes. This establishes viewpoint-conditioned diffusion as a scalable, depth-free solution for stereo generation.

AI.title_translation: StereoSpace：通过规范空间中的端到端扩散实现无深度立体几何合成
AI.tldr: StereoSpace是一个基于扩散的模型，可在规范空间中仅通过视点条件实现无深度单目到立体合成，并引入了无几何体先验的评估协议。它在复杂的非朗伯场景中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一种强大的单目到立体合成框架，该框架能够纯粹通过视点条件来建模几何结构，从而避免使用显式深度或图像扭曲。
AI.method: 提出StereoSpace，一个基于扩散的框架。它利用规范矫正空间和视点条件来指导生成器，实现端到端地推断对应关系和填充遮挡。同时引入了一个排除测试时几何估计的端到端评估协议，该协议使用iSQoE（感知舒适度）和MEt3R（几何一致性）指标。
AI.result: StereoSpace超越了现有的扭曲与修复、潜在扭曲和扭曲条件等类别的方法。它在分层和非朗伯场景中实现了清晰的视差和强大的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 视点条件扩散被确立为一种可扩展的、无深度的立体生成解决方案。
AI.translation: 我们引入了StereoSpace，这是一个基于扩散的单目到立体合成框架，它纯粹通过视点条件来建模几何结构，无需显式深度或扭曲。规范矫正空间和条件指导生成器端到端地推断对应关系并填充遮挡。为了确保公平且无泄漏的评估，我们引入了一个端到端协议，该协议在测试时排除了任何真实值或代理几何估计。该协议强调反映下游相关性的指标：用于感知舒适度的 iSQoE 和用于几何一致性的 MEt3R。StereoSpace超越了来自扭曲与修复、潜在扭曲和扭曲条件类别的其他方法，在分层和非朗伯场景中实现了清晰的视差和强大的鲁棒性。这确立了视点条件扩散作为立体生成的一种可扩展、无深度的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了StereoSpace，一个基于扩散的单目到立体合成框架，它在规范矫正空间中仅通过视点条件来合成几何结构，无需显式深度。该模型能够端到端地处理对应关系和遮挡填充。为确保评估公平，作者引入了新的无几何先验的评估协议（使用iSQoE和MEt3R指标）。实验证明，StereoSpace在复杂场景中性能优于现有方法，确立了视点条件扩散作为立体生成的可扩展、无深度解决方案。
AI.keywords: 立体合成, 扩散模型, 无深度, 视点条件, 规范空间
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于提出了一种无深度、基于扩散的立体合成方法，通过在规范空间中利用视点条件来隐式建模几何结构，从而避免了对显式深度估计的依赖。这提高了模型在处理复杂非朗伯场景时的鲁棒性。此外，引入严格的、排除几何先验的端到端评估协议，对于推动该领域的公平比较具有重要意义。

title: LxCIM: a new rank-based binary classifier performance metric invariant to local exchange of classes
summary: Binary classification is one of the oldest, most prevalent, and studied problems in machine learning. However, the metrics used to evaluate model performance have received comparatively little attention. The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) has long been a standard choice for model comparison. Despite its advantages, AUROC is not always ideal, particularly for problems that are invariant to local exchange of classes (LxC), a new form of metric invariance introduced in this work. To address this limitation, we propose LxCIM (LxC-invariant metric), which is not only rank-based and invariant under local exchange of classes, but also intuitive, logically consistent, and always computable, while enabling more detailed analysis through the cumulative accuracy-decision rate curve. Moreover, LxCIM exhibits clear theoretical connections to AUROC, accuracy, and the area under the accuracy-decision rate curve (AUDRC). These relationships allow for multiple complementary interpretations: as a symmetric form of AUROC, a rank-based analogue of accuracy, or a more representative and more interpretable variant of AUDRC. Finally, we demonstrate the direct applicability of LxCIM to the bivariate causal discovery problem (which exhibits invariance to local exchange of classes) and show how it addresses the acknowledged limitations of existing metrics used in this field. All code and implementation details are publicly available at github.com/tiagobrogueira/Causal-Discovery-In-Exchangeable-Data.

AI.title_translation: LxCIM：一种对局部类别交换不变的新的基于排序的二元分类器性能指标
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的二元分类性能指标 LxCIM，它基于排序，且对局部类别交换 (LxC) 具有不变性，解决了 AUROC 在 LxC 问题上的局限性，并适用于双变量因果发现等领域。
AI.motivation: 尽管二元分类是机器学习中的常见问题，但用于评估模型性能的指标受到的关注相对较少。标准指标 AUROC 在模型性能评估中并非总是理想，尤其对于那些对“局部类别交换”（LxC）（本文引入的一种新的指标不变性形式）具有不变性的问题存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 LxCIM（局部类别交换不变指标）的新性能指标。LxCIM 基于排序，对局部类别交换不变，并通过累积准确率-决策率曲线（cumulative accuracy-decision rate curve）实现更详细的分析。该方法通过理论联系证明了其与 AUROC、准确率和 AUDRC 的关系，并将其应用于双变量因果发现问题。
AI.result: LxCIM 具有直观性、逻辑一致性，并且始终可计算。它提供了多种互补的解释（例如 AUROC 的对称形式、准确率的基于排序的模拟或 AUDRC 的更具代表性和可解释性的变体）。该指标成功解决了双变量因果发现领域中现有指标公认的局限性。
AI.conclusion: LxCIM 是一种新的基于排序的二元分类性能指标，它通过引入局部类别交换（LxC）不变性，克服了标准指标 AUROC 在特定问题上的局限性。LxCIM 具有强大的理论联系和多重解释，特别适用于双变量因果发现等领域。
AI.translation: 二元分类是机器学习中最古老、最普遍、研究最多的问题之一。然而，用于评估模型性能的指标却受到的关注相对较少。曲线下面积（AUROC）长期以来一直是模型比较的标准选择。尽管 AUROC 具有优点，但它并非总是理想的，特别是对于那些对局部类别交换（LxC）（本文引入的一种新的指标不变性形式）具有不变性的问题。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 LxCIM（LxC-不变指标），它不仅基于排序，对局部类别交换不变，而且直观、逻辑一致且始终可计算，同时通过累积准确率-决策率曲线实现了更详细的分析。此外，LxCIM 与 AUROC、准确率以及准确率-决策率曲线下面积（AUDRC）表现出清晰的理论联系。这些关系允许进行多种互补的解释：将其视为 AUROC 的对称形式、准确率的基于排序的模拟，或 AUDRC 的更具代表性和可解释性的变体。最后，我们展示了 LxCIM 对双变量因果发现问题（该问题表现出局部类别交换不变性）的直接适用性，并展示了它如何解决该领域现有指标公认的局限性。所有代码和实施细节均可在 github.com/tiagobrogueira/Causal-Discovery-In-Exchangeable-Data 公开获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LxCIM（局部类别交换不变指标），这是一种新的基于排序的二元分类器性能指标，旨在解决标准指标 AUROC 在面对对局部类别交换（LxC）不变的问题时的局限性。LxCIM 具有直观性、一致性，并能通过累积准确率-决策率曲线进行详细分析。它在理论上与 AUROC、准确率和 AUDRC 紧密相关，并被证明能有效解决双变量因果发现问题中现有评估指标的不足。
AI.keywords: 二元分类, 性能指标, LxCIM, 局部类别交换, 因果发现
AI.comments: 创新点在于引入了“局部类别交换”（LxC）不变性这一新的指标评估概念，并针对性地提出了 LxCIM。该指标解决了标准指标 AUROC 在特定类型问题（如双变量因果发现）中的局限性，增强了评估的准确性和可解释性。其重要性在于为需要 LxC 不变性的机器学习任务提供了一个逻辑一致、理论基础坚实的新的标准评估工具。

title: Classifying Metamorphic versus Single-Fold Proteins with Statistical Learning and AlphaFold2
summary: The remarkable success of AlphaFold2 in providing accurate atomic-level prediction of protein structures from their amino acid sequence has transformed approaches to the protein folding problem. However, its core paradigm of mapping one sequence to one structure may only be appropriate for single-fold proteins with one stable conformation. Metamorphic proteins, which can adopt multiple distinct conformations, have conformational diversity that cannot be adequately modeled by AlphaFold2. Hence, classifying whether a given protein is metamorphic or single-fold remains a critical challenge for both laboratory experiments and computational methods. To address this challenge, we developed a novel classification framework by re-purposing AlphaFold2 to generate conformational ensembles via a multiple sequence alignment sampling method. From these ensembles, we extract a comprehensive set of features characterizing the conformational ensemble's modality and structural dispersion. A random forest classifier trained on a carefully curated benchmark dataset of known metamorphic and single-fold proteins achieves a mean AUC of 0.869 with cross-validation, demonstrating the effectiveness of our integrated approach. Furthermore, by applying our classifier to 600 randomly sampled proteins from the Protein Data Bank, we identified several potential metamorphic protein candidates -- including the 40S ribosomal protein S30, whose conformational change is crucial for its secondary function in antimicrobial defense. By combining AI-driven protein structure prediction with statistical learning, our work provides a powerful new approach for discovering metamorphic proteins and deepens our understanding of their role in their molecular function.

AI.title_translation: 使用统计学习和AlphaFold2对变构蛋白与单折叠蛋白进行分类
AI.tldr: 针对AlphaFold2无法有效处理变构蛋白（多构象）的问题，研究人员开发了一种结合AlphaFold2（用于生成构象集合）和随机森林分类器的新框架，用于区分变构蛋白和单折叠蛋白，实现了0.869的AUC，并成功识别出潜在的新变构蛋白候选者。
AI.motivation: AlphaFold2的“一序列对一结构”范式不适用于能采取多种不同构象的变构蛋白。因此，分类给定蛋白质是变构蛋白还是单折叠蛋白对于实验室实验和计算方法来说仍然是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一种新型分类框架：通过多序列比对（MSA）采样方法重新利用AlphaFold2来生成构象集合。从这些集合中提取表征构象集合模态和结构分散性的综合特征集。最后，使用在精心策划的基准数据集上训练的随机森林分类器进行分类。
AI.result: 在已知变构蛋白和单折叠蛋白的基准数据集上，经过交叉验证，随机森林分类器实现了0.869的平均AUC。此外，将分类器应用于600个PDB中的随机采样蛋白质时，识别出多个潜在的变构蛋白候选者，包括40S核糖体蛋白S30。
AI.conclusion: 本工作通过结合AI驱动的蛋白质结构预测（AlphaFold2）和统计学习，提供了一种发现变构蛋白的强大新方法，并加深了对变构蛋白在其分子功能中作用的理解。
AI.translation: AlphaFold2在根据氨基酸序列提供准确的原子级蛋白质结构预测方面取得了显著成功，这改变了解决蛋白质折叠问题的方法。然而，其核心的“一个序列对应一个结构”范式可能只适用于具有一个稳定构象的单折叠蛋白。变构蛋白可以采取多种不同的构象，其构象多样性无法被AlphaFold2充分建模。因此，分类给定蛋白质是变构蛋白还是单折叠蛋白，对于实验室实验和计算方法来说仍然是一个关键挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的分类框架，通过多序列比对采样方法重新利用AlphaFold2来生成构象集合。从这些集合中，我们提取了一套表征构象集合模态和结构分散性的综合特征集。在精心策划的已知变构蛋白和单折叠蛋白基准数据集上训练的随机森林分类器，通过交叉验证实现了0.869的平均AUC，证明了我们集成方法的有效性。此外，通过将我们的分类器应用于从蛋白质数据库（PDB）中随机采样的600个蛋白质，我们识别出几个潜在的变构蛋白候选者——包括40S核糖体蛋白S30，其构象变化对其在抗菌防御中的次要功能至关重要。通过将AI驱动的蛋白质结构预测与统计学习相结合，我们的工作为发现变构蛋白提供了一种强大的新方法，并加深了我们对其在分子功能中作用的理解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合AlphaFold2和统计学习的新型分类框架，旨在解决AlphaFold2难以准确建模变构蛋白多样构象的问题。该框架通过多序列比对采样方法重新利用AlphaFold2生成蛋白质构象集合，并提取表征其模态和分散性的特征。随后，使用随机森林分类器对这些特征进行训练和分类。该方法在交叉验证中实现了0.869的平均AUC，并成功识别出多个潜在的变构蛋白候选者，为变构蛋白的发现和功能理解提供了新途径。
AI.keywords: 变构蛋白, AlphaFold2, 统计学习, 构象集合, 分类
AI.comments: 本文创新性地解决了AlphaFold2在处理多构象蛋白质（即变构蛋白）时的局限性。通过将AlphaFold2从单一结构预测工具重新定位为构象集合生成工具，并结合统计学习（随机森林）进行特征提取和分类，为识别难以捉摸的变构蛋白提供了一个强大的计算工具。这项工作对于扩大我们对蛋白质折叠复杂性的理解，以及指导未来的实验发现具有重要意义，尤其是在识别出S30等具有潜在功能重要性的变构蛋白候选者方面。

title: A Model-Guided Neural Network Method for the Inverse Scattering Problem
summary: Inverse medium scattering is an ill-posed, nonlinear wave-based imaging problem arising in medical imaging, remote sensing, and non-destructive testing. Machine learning (ML) methods offer increased inference speed and flexibility in capturing prior knowledge of imaging targets relative to classical optimization-based approaches; however, they perform poorly in regimes where the scattering behavior is highly nonlinear. A key limitation is that ML methods struggle to incorporate the physics governing the scattering process, which are typically inferred implicitly from the training data or loosely enforced via architectural design. In this paper, we present a method that endows a machine learning framework with explicit knowledge of problem physics, in the form of a differentiable solver representing the forward model. The proposed method progressively refines reconstructions of the scattering potential using measurements at increasing wave frequencies, following a classical strategy to stabilize recovery. Empirically, we find that our method provides high-quality reconstructions at a fraction of the computational or sampling costs of competing approaches.

AI.title_translation: 一种模型引导的神经网络方法用于逆散射问题
AI.tldr: 本文通过将可微分的物理前向模型（求解器）嵌入神经网络，解决了传统机器学习方法在处理高度非线性逆散射问题时缺乏物理约束的问题，实现了高效且高质量的散射势重建。
AI.motivation: 机器学习（ML）方法在处理高度非线性散射行为时性能不佳，因为它们难以将控制散射过程的物理规律显式地纳入模型中。传统的优化方法速度较慢且灵活性较低。
AI.method: 提出一种将可微分的、代表前向模型的求解器作为显式物理知识融入机器学习框架的方法。该方法采用经典策略，利用增加波频率的测量数据逐步精化散射势的重建。
AI.result: 该方法在计算成本和采样成本上，相较于竞争方法，能以一小部分代价提供高质量的重建结果。
AI.translation: 逆介质散射是一个出现于医学成像、遥感和无损检测中的病态、非线性、基于波的成像问题。与经典的基于优化的方法相比，机器学习（ML）方法在推理速度和捕获成像目标先验知识的灵活性方面有所提高；然而，在散射行为高度非线性的情况下，它们的性能表现不佳。一个关键的局限性在于ML方法难以整合控制散射过程的物理规律，这些规律通常是从训练数据中隐式推断出来，或通过架构设计松散地强制执行。在本文中，我们提出一种方法，它以可微分求解器（代表前向模型）的形式，将问题的物理知识显式地赋予机器学习框架。我们提出的方法遵循经典的稳定恢复策略，利用增加波频率的测量数据逐步精化散射势的重建。经验上，我们发现我们的方法在计算或采样成本上，相较于竞争方法，能以一小部分代价提供高质量的重建。
AI.summary: 为解决逆散射问题中机器学习方法难以整合物理规律的局限性，本文提出一种将可微分的前向模型求解器作为显式物理知识融入神经网络框架的方法。该方法通过逐步增加波频率来精化散射势重建，实证表明其在低计算和采样成本下能获得高质量重建。
AI.keywords: 逆散射问题, 神经​​网络, 物理知识, 可微分求解器, 频率递进
AI.comments: 该方法的创新点在于将可微分的物理前向模型（求解器）作为显式知识融入到神经网络框架中，以解决逆散射问题中ML方法难以整合物理约束的局限性。其重要性在于提高了高非线性散射情况下的成像质量和效率。局限性方面，摘要中未明确提及。

title: Inference for Batched Adaptive Experiments
summary: The advantages of adaptive experiments have led to their rapid adoption in economics, other fields, as well as among practitioners. However, adaptive experiments pose challenges for causal inference. This note suggests a BOLS (batched ordinary least squares) test statistic for inference of treatment effects in adaptive experiments. The statistic provides a precision-equalizing aggregation of per-period treatment-control differences under heteroskedasticity. The combined test statistic is a normalized average of heteroskedastic per-period z-statistics and can be used to construct asymptotically valid confidence intervals. We provide simulation results comparing rejection rates in the typical case with few treatment periods and few (or many) observations per batch.

AI.tldr: 自适应实验的因果推断很困难。本文提出了一种BOLS（分批普通最小二乘）检验统计量，用于在异方差条件下对分批自适应实验中的处理效应进行精确、渐近有效的推断。
AI.motivation: 自适应实验虽然优势显著并被广泛采用，但其设计给因果推断带来了挑战。需要一种新的统计方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种BOLS（分批普通最小二乘）检验统计量。该统计量通过对异方差下的每期处理-控制差异进行精度均衡聚合，形成一个异方差每期 z 统计量的标准化平均值。
AI.result: 该统计量可用于构建渐近有效的置信区间。提供了在典型情况下（处理期数少，每批观察值少或多）比较拒绝率的仿真结果。
AI.conclusion: BOLS检验统计量为自适应实验中的处理效应推断提供了一种渐近有效的方法，能够解决因果推断中的挑战。
AI.translation: 自适应实验的优势促使它们在经济学、其他领域以及实践者中得到快速采用。然而，自适应实验给因果推断带来了挑战。本文提出了一种BOLS（分批普通最小二乘）检验统计量，用于在自适应实验中推断处理效应。该统计量在异方差条件下提供了每期处理-控制差异的精度均衡聚合。组合检验统计量是异方差每期 z 统计量的标准化平均值，可用于构建渐近有效的置信区间。我们提供了模拟结果，比较了在典型情况下（处理期数少，每批观察值少或多）的拒绝率。
AI.summary: 本文针对自适应实验在因果推断中面临的挑战，提出了一种BOLS（分批普通最小二乘）检验统计量。该统计量通过对异方差下的每期处理效应差异进行精度均衡聚合，形成一个标准化的每期 z 统计量平均值。该方法能够构建渐近有效的置信区间，并通过仿真验证了其在分批实验环境下的性能。
AI.keywords: 自适应实验, 因果推断, BOLS, 检验统计量, 异方差性
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了BOLS（分批普通最小二乘）检验统计量来解决自适应实验中因果推断的难题。自适应实验的流行使得精确且有效的推断方法变得至关重要。该方法尤其强调了在存在异方差的情况下实现“精度均衡聚合”，表明其在实际应用中具有较高的鲁棒性。其重要性在于为快速增长的自适应实验领域提供了一个可靠的统计工具，使其结果在统计学上更加可靠。

title: Topology Identification and Inference over Graphs
comments: Contributed chapter to appear in Handbook of Statistics Volume 54: Multidimensional Signal Processing, K. V. Mishra, G. R. Arce, and A. S. R. S. Rao, Editors, Amsterdam, Netherlands, Elsevier, 2026
summary: Topology identification and inference of processes evolving over graphs arise in timely applications involving brain, transportation, financial, power, as well as social and information networks. This chapter provides an overview of graph topology identification and statistical inference methods for multidimensional relational data. Approaches for undirected links connecting graph nodes are outlined, going all the way from correlation metrics to covariance selection, and revealing ties with smooth signal priors. To account for directional (possibly causal) relations among nodal variables and address the limitations of linear time-invariant models in handling dynamic as well as nonlinear dependencies, a principled framework is surveyed to capture these complexities through judiciously selected kernels from a prescribed dictionary. Generalizations are also described via structural equations and vector autoregressions that can exploit attributes such as low rank, sparsity, acyclicity, and smoothness to model dynamic processes over possibly time-evolving topologies. It is argued that this approach supports both batch and online learning algorithms with convergence rate guarantees, is amenable to tensor (that is, multi-way array) formulations as well as decompositions that are well-suited for multidimensional network data, and can seamlessly leverage high-order statistical information.
