title: Toward Quantitative Modeling of Cybersecurity Risks Due to AI Misuse
summary: Advanced AI systems offer substantial benefits but also introduce risks. In 2025, AI-enabled cyber offense has emerged as a concrete example. This technical report applies a quantitative risk modeling methodology (described in full in a companion paper) to this domain. We develop nine detailed cyber risk models that allow analyzing AI uplift as a function of AI benchmark performance. Each model decomposes attacks into steps using the MITRE ATT&CK framework and estimates how AI affects the number of attackers, attack frequency, probability of success, and resulting harm to determine different types of uplift. To produce these estimates with associated uncertainty, we employ both human experts, via a Delphi study, as well as LLM-based simulated experts, both mapping benchmark scores (from Cybench and BountyBench) to risk model factors. Individual estimates are aggregated through Monte Carlo simulation. The results indicate systematic uplift in attack efficacy, speed, and target reach, with different mechanisms of uplift across risk models. We aim for our quantitative risk modeling to fulfill several aims: to help cybersecurity teams prioritize mitigations, AI evaluators design benchmarks, AI developers make more informed deployment decisions, and policymakers obtain information to set risk thresholds. Similar goals drove the shift from qualitative to quantitative assessment over time in other high-risk industries, such as nuclear power. We propose this methodology and initial application attempt as a step in that direction for AI risk management. While our estimates carry significant uncertainty, publishing detailed quantified results can enable experts to pinpoint exactly where they disagree. This helps to collectively refine estimates, something that cannot be done with qualitative assessments alone.

title: EcomBench: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Foundation Agents in E-commerce
summary: Foundation agents have rapidly advanced in their ability to reason and interact with real environments, making the evaluation of their core capabilities increasingly important. While many benchmarks have been developed to assess agent performance, most concentrate on academic settings or artificially designed scenarios while overlooking the challenges that arise in real applications. To address this issue, we focus on a highly practical real-world setting, the e-commerce domain, which involves a large volume of diverse user interactions, dynamic market conditions, and tasks directly tied to real decision-making processes. To this end, we introduce EcomBench, a holistic E-commerce Benchmark designed to evaluate agent performance in realistic e-commerce environments. EcomBench is built from genuine user demands embedded in leading global e-commerce ecosystems and is carefully curated and annotated through human experts to ensure clarity, accuracy, and domain relevance. It covers multiple task categories within e-commerce scenarios and defines three difficulty levels that evaluate agents on key capabilities such as deep information retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and cross-source knowledge integration. By grounding evaluation in real e-commerce contexts, EcomBench provides a rigorous and dynamic testbed for measuring the practical capabilities of agents in modern e-commerce.

title: Luxical: High-Speed Lexical-Dense Text Embeddings
summary: Frontier language model quality increasingly hinges on our ability to organize web-scale text corpora for training. Today's dominant tools trade off speed and flexibility: lexical classifiers (e.g., FastText) are fast but limited to producing classification output scores, while the vector-valued outputs of transformer text embedding models flexibly support numerous workflows (e.g., clustering, classification, and retrieval) but are computationally expensive to produce. We introduce Luxical, a library for high-speed "lexical-dense" text embeddings that aims to recover the best properties of both approaches for web-scale text organization. Luxical combines sparse TF--IDF features, a small ReLU network, and a knowledge distillation training regimen to approximate large transformer embedding models at a fraction of their operational cost. In this technical report, we describe the Luxical architecture and training objective and evaluate a concrete Luxical model in two disparate applications: a targeted webcrawl document retrieval test and an end-to-end language model data curation task grounded in text classification. In these tasks we demonstrate speedups ranging from 3x to 100x over varying-sized neural baselines, and comparable to FastText model inference during the data curation task. On these evaluations, the tested Luxical model illustrates favorable compute/quality trade-offs for large-scale text organization, matching the quality of neural baselines. Luxical is available as open-source software at https://github.com/datologyai/luxical.

title: Semantic Trajectory Generation for Goal-Oriented Spacecraft Rendezvous
comments: 28 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to AIAA SCITECH 2026
summary: Reliable real-time trajectory generation is essential for future autonomous spacecraft. While recent progress in nonconvex guidance and control is paving the way for onboard autonomous trajectory optimization, these methods still rely on extensive expert input (e.g., waypoints, constraints, mission timelines, etc.), which limits the operational scalability in real rendezvous missions. This paper introduces SAGES (Semantic Autonomous Guidance Engine for Space), a trajectory-generation framework that translates natural-language commands into spacecraft trajectories that reflect high-level intent while respecting nonconvex constraints. Experiments in two settings -- fault-tolerant proximity operations with continuous-time constraint enforcement and a free-flying robotic platform -- demonstrate that SAGES reliably produces trajectories aligned with human commands, achieving over 90% semantic-behavioral consistency across diverse behavior modes. Ultimately, this work marks an initial step toward language-conditioned, constraint-aware spacecraft trajectory generation, enabling operators to interactively guide both safety and behavior through intuitive natural-language commands with reduced expert burden.
comment: 28 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to AIAA SCITECH 2026

title: Relightable and Dynamic Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction from Monocular Video
comments: 8 pages, 9 figures, published in ACM MM 2025
summary: Modeling relightable and animatable human avatars from monocular video is a long-standing and challenging task. Recently, Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have been employed to reconstruct the avatars. However, they often produce unsatisfactory photo-realistic results because of insufficient geometrical details related to body motion, such as clothing wrinkles. In this paper, we propose a 3DGS-based human avatar modeling framework, termed as Relightable and Dynamic Gaussian Avatar (RnD-Avatar), that presents accurate pose-variant deformation for high-fidelity geometrical details. To achieve this, we introduce dynamic skinning weights that define the human avatar's articulation based on pose while also learning additional deformations induced by body motion. We also introduce a novel regularization to capture fine geometric details under sparse visual cues. Furthermore, we present a new multi-view dataset with varied lighting conditions to evaluate relight. Our framework enables realistic rendering of novel poses and views while supporting photo-realistic lighting effects under arbitrary lighting conditions. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in novel view synthesis, novel pose rendering, and relighting.
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, published in ACM MM 2025

title: Development and Testing for Perception Based Autonomous Landing of a Long-Range QuadPlane
summary: QuadPlanes combine the range efficiency of fixed-wing aircraft with the maneuverability of multi-rotor platforms for long-range autonomous missions. In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, perception-based landing is vital for reliable operation. Unlike structured landing zones, real-world sites are unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization capabilities from the perception system. Deep neural networks (DNNs) provide a scalable solution for learning landing site features across diverse visual and environmental conditions. While perception-driven landing has been shown in simulation, real-world deployment introduces significant challenges. Payload and volume constraints limit high-performance edge AI devices like the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, which are crucial for real-time detection and control. Accurate pose estimation during descent is necessary, especially in the absence of GPS, and relies on dependable visual-inertial odometry. Achieving this with limited edge AI resources requires careful optimization of the entire deployment framework. The flight characteristics of large QuadPlanes further complicate the problem. These aircraft exhibit high inertia, reduced thrust vectoring, and slow response times further complicate stable landing maneuvers. This work presents a lightweight QuadPlane system for efficient vision-based autonomous landing and visual-inertial odometry, specifically developed for long-range QuadPlane operations such as aerial monitoring. It describes the hardware platform, sensor configuration, and embedded computing architecture designed to meet demanding real-time, physical constraints. This establishes a foundation for deploying autonomous landing in dynamic, unstructured, GPS-denied environments.

title: StereoWorld: Geometry-Aware Monocular-to-Stereo Video Generation
summary: The growing adoption of XR devices has fueled strong demand for high-quality stereo video, yet its production remains costly and artifact-prone. To address this challenge, we present StereoWorld, an end-to-end framework that repurposes a pretrained video generator for high-fidelity monocular-to-stereo video generation. Our framework jointly conditions the model on the monocular video input while explicitly supervising the generation with a geometry-aware regularization to ensure 3D structural fidelity. A spatio-temporal tiling scheme is further integrated to enable efficient, high-resolution synthesis. To enable large-scale training and evaluation, we curate a high-definition stereo video dataset containing over 11M frames aligned to natural human interpupillary distance (IPD). Extensive experiments demonstrate that StereoWorld substantially outperforms prior methods, generating stereo videos with superior visual fidelity and geometric consistency. The project webpage is available at https://ke-xing.github.io/StereoWorld/.

title: Perception-Inspired Color Space Design for Photo White Balance Editing
summary:
White balance (WB) is a key step in the image signal processor (ISP) pipeline that mitigates color casts caused by varying illumination and restores the scene's true colors. Currently, sRGB-based WB editing for post-ISP WB correction is widely used to address color constancy failures in the ISP pipeline when the original camera RAW is unavailable. However, additive color models (e.g., sRGB) are inherently limited by fixed nonlinear transformations and entangled color channels, which often impede their generalization to complex lighting conditions.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework for WB correction that leverages a perception-inspired Learnable HSI (LHSI) color space. Built upon a cylindrical color model that naturally separates luminance from chromatic components, our framework further introduces dedicated parameters to enhance this disentanglement and learnable mapping to adaptively refine the flexibility. Moreover, a new Mamba-based network is introduced, which is tailored to the characteristics of the proposed LHSI color space.
  Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method, highlighting the potential of perception-inspired color space design in computational photography. The source code is available at https://github.com/YangCheng58/WB_Color_Space.

title: Advancing Mathematical Research via Human-AI Interactive Theorem Proving
summary: We investigate how large language models can be used as research tools in scientific computing while preserving mathematical rigor. We propose a human-in-the-loop workflow for interactive theorem proving and discovery with LLMs. Human experts retain control over problem formulation and admissible assumptions, while the model searches for proofs or contradictions, proposes candidate properties and theorems, and helps construct structures and parameters that satisfy explicit constraints, supported by numerical experiments and simple verification checks. Experts treat these outputs as raw material, further refine them, and organize the results into precise statements and rigorous proofs. We instantiate this workflow in a case study on the connection between manifold optimization and Grover's quantum search algorithm, where the pipeline helps identify invariant subspaces, explore Grover-compatible retractions, and obtain convergence guarantees for the retraction-based gradient method. The framework provides a practical template for integrating large language models into frontier mathematical research, enabling faster exploration of proof space and algorithm design while maintaining transparent reasoning responsibilities. Although illustrated on manifold optimization problems in quantum computing, the principles extend to other core areas of scientific computing.

title: StateSpace-SSL: Linear-Time Self-supervised Learning for Plant Disease Detection
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is attractive for plant disease detection as it can exploit large collections of unlabeled leaf images, yet most existing SSL methods are built on CNNs or vision transformers that are poorly matched to agricultural imagery. CNN-based SSL struggles to capture disease patterns that evolve continuously along leaf structures, while transformer-based SSL introduces quadratic attention cost from high-resolution patches. To address these limitations, we propose StateSpace-SSL, a linear-time SSL framework that employs a Vision Mamba state-space encoder to model long-range lesion continuity through directional scanning across the leaf surface. A prototype-driven teacher-student objective aligns representations across multiple views, encouraging stable and lesion-aware features from labelled data. Experiments on three publicly available plant disease datasets show that StateSpace-SSL consistently outperforms the CNN- and transformer-based SSL baselines in various evaluation metrics. Qualitative analyses further confirm that it learns compact, lesion-focused feature maps, highlighting the advantage of linear state-space modelling for self-supervised plant disease representation learning.

title: SWEnergy: An Empirical Study on Energy Efficiency in Agentic Issue Resolution Frameworks with SLMs
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to AGENT 2026 (ICSE 2026 workshop)
summary:
Context. LLM-based autonomous agents in software engineering rely on large, proprietary models, limiting local deployment. This has spurred interest in Small Language Models (SLMs), but their practical effectiveness and efficiency within complex agentic frameworks for automated issue resolution remain poorly understood.
  Goal. We investigate the performance, energy efficiency, and resource consumption of four leading agentic issue resolution frameworks when deliberately constrained to using SLMs. We aim to assess the viability of these systems for this task in resource-limited settings and characterize the resulting trade-offs.
  Method. We conduct a controlled evaluation of four leading agentic frameworks (SWE-Agent, OpenHands, Mini SWE Agent, AutoCodeRover) using two SLMs (Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3 1.7B) on the SWE-bench Verified Mini benchmark. On fixed hardware, we measure energy, duration, token usage, and memory over 150 runs per configuration.
  Results. We find that framework architecture is the primary driver of energy consumption. The most energy-intensive framework, AutoCodeRover (Gemma), consumed 9.4x more energy on average than the least energy-intensive, OpenHands (Gemma). However, this energy is largely wasted. Task resolution rates were near-zero, demonstrating that current frameworks, when paired with SLMs, consume significant energy on unproductive reasoning loops. The SLM's limited reasoning was the bottleneck for success, but the framework's design was the bottleneck for efficiency.
  Conclusions. Current agentic frameworks, designed for powerful LLMs, fail to operate efficiently with SLMs. We find that framework architecture is the primary driver of energy consumption, but this energy is largely wasted due to the SLMs' limited reasoning. Viable low-energy solutions require shifting from passive orchestration to architectures that actively manage SLM weaknesses.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to AGENT 2026 (ICSE 2026 workshop)

title: Mastering Diverse, Unknown, and Cluttered Tracks for Robust Vision-Based Drone Racing
comments: 8 pages, 9 figures, accepted to Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Most reinforcement learning(RL)-based methods for drone racing target fixed, obstacle-free tracks, leaving the generalization to unknown, cluttered environments largely unaddressed. This challenge stems from the need to balance racing speed and collision avoidance, limited feasible space causing policy exploration trapped in local optima during training, and perceptual ambiguity between gates and obstacles in depth maps-especially when gate positions are only coarsely specified. To overcome these issues, we propose a two-phase learning framework: an initial soft-collision training phase that preserves policy exploration for high-speed flight, followed by a hard-collision refinement phase that enforces robust obstacle avoidance. An adaptive, noise-augmented curriculum with an asymmetric actor-critic architecture gradually shifts the policy's reliance from privileged gate-state information to depth-based visual input. We further impose Lipschitz constraints and integrate a track-primitive generator to enhance motion stability and cross-environment generalization. We evaluate our framework through extensive simulation and ablation studies, and validate it in real-world experiments on a computationally constrained quadrotor. The system achieves agile flight while remaining robust to gate-position errors, developing a generalizable drone racing framework with the capability to operate in diverse, partially unknown and cluttered environments. https://yufengsjtu.github.io/MasterRacing.github.io/
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, accepted to Robotics and Automation Letters

title: UnReflectAnything: RGB-Only Highlight Removal by Rendering Synthetic Specular Supervision
summary: Specular highlights distort appearance, obscure texture, and hinder geometric reasoning in both natural and surgical imagery. We present UnReflectAnything, an RGB-only framework that removes highlights from a single image by predicting a highlight map together with a reflection-free diffuse reconstruction. The model uses a frozen vision transformer encoder to extract multi-scale features, a lightweight head to localize specular regions, and a token-level inpainting module that restores corrupted feature patches before producing the final diffuse image. To overcome the lack of paired supervision, we introduce a Virtual Highlight Synthesis pipeline that renders physically plausible specularities using monocular geometry, Fresnel-aware shading, and randomized lighting which enables training on arbitrary RGB images with correct geometric structure. UnReflectAnything generalizes across natural and surgical domains where non-Lambertian surfaces and non-uniform lighting create severe highlights and it achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks. Project Page: https://alberto-rota.github.io/UnReflectAnything/

title: Exqutor: Extended Query Optimizer for Vector-augmented Analytical Queries
summary: Vector similarity search is becoming increasingly important for data science pipelines, particularly in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where it enhances large language model inference by enabling efficient retrieval of relevant external knowledge. As RAG expands with table-augmented generation to incorporate structured data, workloads integrating table and vector search are becoming more prevalent. However, efficiently executing such queries remains challenging due to inaccurate cardinality estimation for vector search components, leading to suboptimal query plans. In this paper, we propose Exqutor, an extended query optimizer for vector-augmented analytical queries. Exqutor is a pluggable cardinality estimation framework designed to address this issue, leveraging exact cardinality query optimization techniques to enhance estimation accuracy when vector indexes (e.g., HNSW, IVF) are available. In scenarios lacking these indexes, we employ a sampling-based approach with adaptive sampling size adjustment, dynamically tuning the sample size to balance estimation accuracy and sampling overhead. This allows Exqutor to efficiently approximate vector search cardinalities while minimizing computational costs. We integrate our framework into pgvector, VBASE, and DuckDB, demonstrating performance improvements of up to four orders of magnitude on vector-augmented analytical queries.

title: Towards Practical and Usable In-network Classification
summary: In-network machine learning enables real-time classification directly on network hardware, offering consistently low inference latency. However, current solutions are limited by strict hardware constraints, scarce on-device resources, and poor usability, making them impractical for ML developers and cloud operators. To this end, we propose ACORN, an end-to-end system that automates the distributed deployment of practical machine learning models across the network. ACORN provides a fully automated pipeline that loads and deploys Python ML models on network devices using an optimized deployment plan from an ILP planner. To support larger models under hardware constraints and allow runtime programmability, ACORN adopts a novel data plane representation for Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine models. We implement ACORN prototype in P4 and run it on real programmable hardware. Our evaluation shows ACORN can deploy classification ML models with 2-4x more features than state-of-the-art solutions, while imposing negligible overhead on network performance and traffic. We will make our data plane program, model translator, optimizer, and all related scripts publicly available.

title: LLMs in Interpreting Legal Documents
summary: This chapter explores the application of Large Language Models in the legal domain, showcasing their potential to optimise and augment traditional legal tasks by analysing possible use cases, such as assisting in interpreting statutes, contracts, and case law, enhancing clarity in legal summarisation, contract negotiation, and information retrieval. There are several challenges that can arise from the application of such technologies, such as algorithmic monoculture, hallucinations, and compliance with existing regulations, including the EU's AI Act and recent U.S. initiatives, alongside the emerging approaches in China. Furthermore, two different benchmarks are presented.

title: ReViSE: Towards Reason-Informed Video Editing in Unified Models with Self-Reflective Learning
summary: Video unified models exhibit strong capabilities in understanding and generation, yet they struggle with reason-informed visual editing even when equipped with powerful internal vision-language models (VLMs). We attribute this gap to two factors: 1) existing datasets are inadequate for training and evaluating reasoning-aware video editing, and 2) an inherent disconnect between the models' reasoning and editing capabilities, which prevents the rich understanding from effectively instructing the editing process. Bridging this gap requires an integrated framework that connects reasoning with visual transformation. To address this gap, we introduce the Reason-Informed Video Editing (RVE) task, which requires reasoning about physical plausibility and causal dynamics during editing. To support systematic evaluation, we construct RVE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with two complementary subsets: Reasoning-Informed Video Editing and In-Context Video Generation. These subsets cover diverse reasoning dimensions and real-world editing scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we propose the ReViSE, a Self-Reflective Reasoning (SRF) framework that unifies generation and evaluation within a single architecture. The model's internal VLM provides intrinsic feedback by assessing whether the edited video logically satisfies the given instruction. The differential feedback that refines the generator's reasoning behavior during training. Extensive experiments on RVE-Bench demonstrate that ReViSE significantly enhances editing accuracy and visual fidelity, achieving a 32% improvement of the Overall score in the reasoning-informed video editing subset over state-of-the-art methods.

title: Polymer Dynamics via Cliques: New Conditions for Approximations
summary: Abstract polymer models are systems of weighted objects, called polymers, equipped with an incompatibility relation. An important quantity associated with such models is the partition function, which is the weighted sum over all sets of compatible polymers. Various approximation problems reduce to approximating the partition function of a polymer model. Central to the existence of such approximation algorithms are weight conditions of the respective polymer model. Such conditions are derived either via complex analysis or via probabilistic arguments. We follow the latter path and establish a new condition -- the clique dynamics condition -- , which is less restrictive than the ones in the literature. We introduce a new Markov chain where the clique dynamics condition implies rapid mixing by utilizing cliques of incompatible polymers that naturally arise from the translation of algorithmic problems into polymer models. This leads to improved parameter ranges for several approximation algorithms, such as a factor of at least $2^{1/α}$ for the hard-core model on bipartite $α$-expanders.

title: On the minimum number of inversions to make a digraph $k$-(arc-)strong
Performance Analysis of Quantum CSS Error-Correcting Codes via MacWilliams Identities
comments: 25 pages, 10 figures, accepted in Quantum journal
summary: We analyze the performance of quantum stabilizer codes, one of the most important classes for practical implementations, on both symmetric and asymmetric quantum channels. To this aim, we first derive the weight enumerator (WE) for the undetectable errors based on the quantum MacWilliams identities. The WE is then used to evaluate tight upper bounds on the error rate of CSS quantum codes with \acl{MW} decoding. For surface codes we also derive a simple closed form expression of the bounds over the depolarizing channel. We introduce a novel approach that combines the knowledge of WE with a logical operator analysis, allowing the derivation of the exact asymptotic error rate for short codes. For example, on a depolarizing channel with physical error rate $ρ\to 0$, the logical error rate $ρ_\mathrm{L}$ is asymptotically $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 16 ρ^2$ for the $[[9,1,3]]$ Shor code, $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 16.3 ρ^2$ for the $[[7,1,3]]$ Steane code, $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 18.7 ρ^2$ for the $[[13,1,3]]$ surface code, and $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 149.3 ρ^3$ for the $[[41,1,5]]$ surface code. For larger codes our bound provides $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 1215 ρ^4$ and $ρ_\mathrm{L} \approx 663 ρ^5$ for the $[[85,1,7]]$ and the $[[181,1,10]]$ surface codes, respectively. Finally, we extend our analysis to include realistic, noisy syndrome extraction circuits by modeling error propagation throughout gadgets. This enables estimation of logical error rates under faulty measurements. The performance analysis serves as a design tool for developing fault-tolerant quantum systems by guiding the selection of quantum codes based on their error correction capability. Additionally, it offers a novel perspective on quantum degeneracy, showing it represents the fraction of non-correctable error patterns shared by multiple logical operators.
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, accepted in Quantum journal

title: Unconditional correctness of recent quantum algorithms for factoring and computing discrete logarithms
comments: To appear in Forum of Mathematics, Pi. Includes a new explanatory section. 25 pages
summary: In 1994, Shor introduced his famous quantum algorithm to factor integers and compute discrete logarithms in polynomial time. In 2023, Regev proposed a multi-dimensional version of Shor's algorithm that requires far fewer quantum gates. His algorithm relies on a number-theoretic conjecture on the elements in $(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})^{\times}$ that can be written as short products of very small prime numbers. We prove a version of this conjecture using tools from analytic number theory such as zero-density estimates. As a result, we obtain an unconditional proof of correctness of this improved quantum algorithm and of subsequent variants.
comment: To appear in Forum of Mathematics, Pi. Includes a new explanatory section. 25 pages

title: Equivariant Test-Time Training with Operator Sketching for Imaging Inverse Problems
summary: Equivariant Imaging (EI) regularization has become the de-facto technique for unsupervised training of deep imaging networks, without any need of ground-truth data. Observing that the EI-based unsupervised training paradigm currently has significant computational redundancy leading to inefficiency in high-dimensional applications, we propose a sketched EI regularization which leverages the randomized sketching techniques for acceleration. We apply our sketched EI regularization to develop an accelerated deep internal learning framework, which can be efficiently applied for test-time network adaptation. Additionally, for network adaptation tasks, we propose a parameter-efficient approach to accelerate both EI and Sketched-EI via optimizing only the normalization layers. Our numerical study on X-ray CT and multicoil magnetic resonance image reconstruction tasks demonstrate that our approach can achieve significant computational acceleration over the standard EI counterpart, especially in test-time training tasks.

title: Lightweight Model Attribution and Detection of Synthetic Speech via Audio Residual Fingerprints
summary: As speech generation technologies advance, so do risks of impersonation, misinformation, and spoofing. We present a lightweight, training-free approach for detecting synthetic speech and attributing it to its source model. Our method addresses three tasks: (1) single-model attribution in an open-world setting, (2) multi-model attribution in a closed-world setting, and (3) real vs. synthetic speech classification. The core idea is simple: we compute standardized average residuals--the difference between an audio signal and its filtered version--to extract model-agnostic fingerprints that capture synthesis artifacts. Experiments across multiple synthesis systems and languages show AUROC scores above 99%, with strong reliability even when only a subset of model outputs is available. The method maintains high performance under common audio distortions, including echo and moderate background noise, while data augmentation can improve results in more challenging conditions. In addition, out-of-domain detection is performed using Mahalanobis distances to in-domain residual fingerprints, achieving an F1 score of 0.91 on unseen models, reinforcing the method's efficiency, generalizability, and suitability for digital forensics and security applications.

title: Extrapolating Jet Radiation with Autoregressive Transformers
comments: v1: 31 pages, 4 tables, 15 figures; v2: 31 pages, 4 tables, 16 figures, accepted for publication at SciPost Physics
summary: Generative networks are an exciting tool for fast LHC event fixed number of particles. Autoregressive transformers allow us to generate events containing variable numbers of particles, very much in line with the physics of QCD jet radiation, and offer the possibility to generalize to higher multiplicities. We show how transformers can learn a factorized likelihood for jet radiation and extrapolate in terms of the number of generated jets. For this extrapolation, bootstrapping training data and training with modifications of the likelihood loss can be used.
comment: v1: 31 pages, 4 tables, 15 figures; v2: 31 pages, 4 tables, 16 figures, accepted for publication at SciPost Physics

title: Beyond Log-Concavity and Score Regularity: Improved Convergence Bounds for Score-Based Generative Models in W2-distance
summary: Score-based Generative Models (SGMs) aim to sample from a target distribution by learning score functions using samples perturbed by Gaussian noise. Existing convergence bounds for SGMs in the W2-distance rely on stringent assumptions about the data distribution. In this work, we present a novel framework for analyzing W2-convergence in SGMs, significantly relaxing traditional assumptions such as log-concavity and score regularity. Leveraging the regularization properties of the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck (OU) process, we show that weak log-concavity of the data distribution evolves into log-concavity over time. This transition is rigorously quantified through a PDE-based analysis of the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation governing the log-density of the forward process. Moreover, we establish that the drift of the time-reversed OU process alternates between contractive and non-contractive regimes, reflecting the dynamics of concavity. Our approach circumvents the need for stringent regularity conditions on the score function and its estimators, relying instead on milder, more practical assumptions. We demonstrate the wide applicability of this framework through explicit computations on Gaussian mixture models, illustrating its versatility and potential for broader classes of data distributions.

title: Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers for Multi-Target DOA Estimation
comments: 6 pages, 7 figures, accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: Quantum sensing technologies have experienced rapid progresses since entering the `second quantum revolution'. Among various candidates, schemes relying on Rydberg atoms exhibit compelling advantages for detecting radio frequency signals. Based on this, Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQRs) have emerged as a promising solution to classical wireless communication and sensing. To harness the advantages and exploit the potential of RAQRs in wireless sensing, we investigate the realization of the direction of arrival (DOA) estimation by RAQRs. Specifically, we first conceive a Rydberg atomic quantum uniform linear array (RAQ-ULA) aided wireless receiver for multi-target DOA detection and propose the corresponding signal model of this sensing system. Our model reveals that the presence of the radio-frequency local oscillator in the RAQ-ULA creates sensor gain mismatches, which degrade the DOA estimation significantly by employing the classical Estimation of Signal Parameters via Rotational Invariant Techniques (ESPRIT). To solve this sensor gain mismatch problem, we propose the Rydberg atomic quantum ESPRIT (RAQ-ESPRIT) relying on our model. Lastly, we characterize our scheme through numerical simulations, where the results exhibit that it is capable of reducing the estimation error of its classical counterpart on the order of $> 400$-fold and $> 9000$-fold in the PSL and SQL, respectively.
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology

title: Sublinear Variational Optimization of Gaussian Mixture Models with Millions to Billions of Parameters
comments: 31 pages, 8 figures (and 28 pages, 7 figures in Appendix)
summary: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) range among the most frequently used models in machine learning. However, training large, general GMMs becomes computationally prohibitive for datasets that have many data points $N$ of high-dimensionality $D$. For GMMs with arbitrary covariances, we here derive a highly efficient variational approximation, which is then integrated with mixtures of factor analyzers (MFAs). For GMMs with $C$ components, our proposed algorithm substantially reduces runtime complexity from $\mathcal{O}(NCD^2)$ per iteration to a complexity scaling linearly with $D$ and sublinearly with $NC$. In numerical experiments, we first validate that the complexity reduction results in a sublinear scaling for the entire GMM optimization process. Second, we show on large-scale benchmarks that the sublinear algorithm results in speed-ups of an order-of-magnitude compared to the state-of-the-art. Third, as a proof of concept, we finally train GMMs with over 10 billion parameters on about 100 million images, observing training times of less than nine hours on a single state-of-the-art CPU. Finally, and forth, we demonstrate the effectiveness of large-scale GMMs on the task of zero-shot image denoising, where sublinear training results in state-of-the-art denoising times while competitive denoising performance is maintained.
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures (and 28 pages, 7 figures in Appendix)

title: Tight relations and equivalences between smooth relative entropies
comments: 37+7 pages. v4: major improvements and additions (Lemma 10, Lemma 11, Proposition 17); all inequalities derived in the main result (Theorem 12) are now tight
summary: The precise one-shot characterisation of operational tasks in classical and quantum information theory relies on different forms of smooth entropic quantities. A particularly important connection is between the hypothesis testing relative entropy and the smoothed max-relative entropy, which together govern many operational settings. We first strengthen this connection into a type of equivalence: we show that the hypothesis testing relative entropy is equivalent to a variant of the smooth max-relative entropy based on the information spectrum divergence, which can be alternatively understood as a measured smooth max-relative entropy. Furthermore, we improve a fundamental lemma due to Datta and Renner that connects the different variants of the smoothed max-relative entropy, introducing a modified proof technique based on matrix geometric means and a tightened gentle measurement lemma. We use the unveiled connections and tools to strictly improve on previously known one-shot bounds and duality relations between the smooth max-relative entropy and the hypothesis testing relative entropy, establishing provably tight bounds between them. We use these results to refine other divergence inequalities, in particular sharpening bounds that connect the max-relative entropy with Rényi divergences.
comment: 37+7 pages. v4: major improvements and additions (Lemma 10, Lemma 11, Proposition 17); all inequalities derived in the main result (Theorem 12) are now tight

title: MFC 5.0: An exascale many-physics flow solver
summary: Many problems of interest in engineering, medicine, and the fundamental sciences rely on high-fidelity flow simulation, making performant computational fluid dynamics solvers a mainstay of the open-source software community. Previous work, MFC 3.0, was published, documented, and made open-source by Bryngelson et al. CPC (2021) features numerous physical features, numerical methods, and scalable infrastructure. MFC 5.0 is a significant update to MFC 3.0, featuring a broad set of well-established and novel physical models and numerical methods, as well as the introduction of GPU and APU (or superchip) acceleration. We exhibit state-of-the-art performance and ideal scaling on the first two exascale supercomputers, OLCF's Frontier and LLNL's El Capitan. Combined with MFC's single-accelerator performance, MFC achieves exascale computation in practice and has achieved the largest-to-date public CFD simulation at 200 trillion grid points, earning it a 2025 ACM Gordon Bell Prize finalist. New physical features include the immersed boundary method, $N$-fluid phase change, Euler-Euler and Euler-Lagrange sub-grid bubble models, fluid-structure interaction, hypo- and hyper-elastic materials, chemically reacting flow, two-material surface tension, magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), and more. Numerical techniques now represent the current state-of-the-art, including general relaxation characteristic boundary conditions, WENO variants, Strang splitting for stiff sub-grid flow features, and low Mach number treatments. Weak scaling to tens of thousands of GPUs on OLCF's Summit and Frontier, and LLNL's El Capitan, achieves efficiencies within 5% of ideal to over 90% of their respective system sizes. Strong scaling results for a 16-fold increase in device count show parallel efficiencies exceeding 90% on OLCF Frontier.

AI.title_translation: MFC 5.0：一个E级多物理场流体求解器

title: The biequivalence of path categories and axiomatic Martin-Löf type theories
comments: This is the full version of the CSL2026 paper with the same title. Compared to the previous preprint, we reformulated the results in a different semantic framework: from comprehension categories to display map categories. We made this change because display map categories are closer to path categories so that we can focus on the simplification they give by using equivalences as a primitive notion
summary:
The semantics of extensional type theory has an elegant categorical description: models of extensional =-types, 1-types, and Sigma-types are biequivalent to finitely complete categories, while adding Pi-types yields locally Cartesian closed categories. We establish parallel results for axiomatic type theory, which includes systems like cubical type theory, where the computation rule of the =-types only holds as a propositional axiom instead of a definitional reduction. In particular, we prove that models of axiomatic =-types, and standard 1- and Sigma-types are biequivalent to certain path categories, while adding axiomatic Pi-types yields dependent homotopy exponents.
  This biequivalence simplifies axiomatic =-types, which are more intricate than extensional ones since they permit higher dimensional structure. Specifically, path categories use a primitive notion of equivalence instead of a direct reproduction of the syntactic elimination rules and computation axioms. We apply our correspondence to prove a coherence theorem: we show that these weak homotopical models can be turned into equivalent strict models of axiomatic type theory. In addition, we introduce a more modular notion, that of a display map path category, which only models axiomatic =-types by default, while leaving room to add other axiomatic type formers such as 1-, Sigma-, and Pi-types.
comment: This is the full version of the CSL2026 paper with the same title. Compared to the previous preprint, we reformulated the results in a different semantic framework: from comprehension categories to display map categories. We made this change because display map categories are closer to path categories so that we can focus on the simplification they give by using equivalences as a primitive notion

AI.title_translation: 路径范畴与公理化Martin-Löf类型理论的双等价性
AI.tldr: 本文建立了公理化（如立方）类型理论（Axiomatic Type Theory）模型与路径范畴（Path Categories）之间的双等价性。这简化了处理公理化等价类型（=-types）的复杂性，并证明了一个相干性定理。
AI.motivation: 现有外延类型理论（extensional type theory）的语义有优雅的范畴描述。作者旨在为公理化类型理论（如立方类型理论，其中等价类型的计算规则仅作为命题公理而非定义性归约）建立平行的范畴语义结果。
AI.method: 建立公理化类型理论模型与特定路径范畴之间的双等价性。具体来说，公理化等价类型、1-类型和Sigma-类型与路径范畴双等价；增加公理化Pi-类型则与依赖同伦指数双等价。方法论上，路径范畴使用原始的等价概念，而非直接复制句法消除规则。此外，引入了更模块化的“显示映射路径范畴”概念。
AI.result: 1. 证明了公理化等价类型、标准1-类型和Sigma-类型模型与特定路径范畴是双等价的。2. 证明了增加公理化Pi-类型后，模型与依赖同伦指数双等价。3. 证明了一个相干性定理：弱同伦模型可以转化为等价的严格公理化类型理论模型。
AI.conclusion: 建立了公理化类型理论与其范畴模型（路径范畴）之间的双等价性，这简化了对允许高维结构的公理化等价类型的处理，并证明了模型之间的相干性。
AI.translation: 外延类型理论的语义具有优雅的范畴描述：外延等价类型（=-types）、1-类型和Sigma-类型模型与有限完备范畴双等价，而增加Pi-类型则产生局部笛卡尔闭范畴。我们为公理化类型理论（包括如立方类型理论等系统，其中等价类型（=-types）的计算规则仅作为命题公理而非定义性归约）建立了平行的结果。特别是，我们证明了公理化等价类型、标准1-类型和Sigma-类型模型与某些路径范畴是双等价的，而增加公理化Pi-类型则产生依赖同伦指数。这种双等价性简化了公理化等价类型，后者比外延类型更复杂，因为它允许更高维的结构。具体来说，路径范畴使用原始的等价概念，而不是直接复制句法消除规则和计算公理。我们应用这种对应关系来证明一个相干性定理：我们表明这些弱同伦模型可以转化为等价的严格公理化类型理论模型。此外，我们引入了一个更模块化的概念，即显示映射路径范畴（display map path category），它默认只对公理化等价类型进行建模，同时为添加其他公理化类型构造器（如1-类型、Sigma-类型和Pi-类型）留有余地。
AI.summary: 本文为公理化Martin-Löf类型理论（如立方类型理论）建立了范畴语义。与外延类型理论模型对应于有限完备范畴类似，作者证明了公理化等价类型、1-类型和Sigma-类型模型与路径范畴之间存在双等价性。这种对应关系通过使用原始等价概念简化了对复杂公理化等价类型的处理。通过这一框架，论文证明了一个相干性定理，即弱同伦模型可以严格化，并引入了模块化的显示映射路径范畴概念。
AI.keywords: 路径范畴, 公理化类型理论, 双等价性, Martin-Löf类型理论, 相干性定理
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将经典的外延类型理论的范畴语义框架扩展到了更现代、更复杂的公理化类型理论（如用于同伦类型理论的立方类型理论）。通过引入“路径范畴”作为公理化类型理论的语义模型，作者成功地处理了公理化等价类型中固有的高维结构和较弱的计算规则。建立的双等价性不仅提供了理论基础，而且通过使用原始的等价概念替代复杂的句法规则，极大地简化了模型的构建。相干性定理的证明对于确保弱模型和严格模型之间的关系至关重要，为后续研究奠定了坚实的基础。

title: A note on the quantum Wielandt inequality
comments: 7 pages; the author was supported in part by US National Science Foundation Grant No. DMS-2153946
summary: In this note, we prove that the index of primitivity of any primitive unital Schwarz map is at most $2(D-1)^2$, where $D$ is the dimension of the underlying matrix algebra. This inequality was first proved by Rahaman for Schwarz maps which were both unital and trace preserving. As we show, the assumption of unitality is basically innocuous, but in general not all primitive unital Schwarz maps are trace preserving. Therefore, the precise purpose of this note is to showcase how to apply the method of Rahaman to unital primitive Schwarz maps that don't preserve trace. As a corollary of this theorem, we show that the index of primitivity of any primitive 2-positive map is at most $2(D-1)^2$, so in particular this bound holds for arbitrary primitive completely positive maps. We briefly discuss of how this relates to a conjecture of Perez-Garcia, Verstraete, Wolf and Cirac.
comment: 7 pages; the author was supported in part by US National Science Foundation Grant No. DMS-2153946

AI.title_translation: 量子Wielandt不等式的一个注记
AI.tldr: 本文将原始幺正Schwarz映射的本原性指数的上界扩展到不保持迹的情况，界限为 $2(D-1)^2$，并应用了Rahaman方法的修改版本。
AI.motivation: Rahaman此前证明了针对既是幺正又保持迹的原始Schwarz映射的本原性指数的界限。本文的目的是展示如何将Rahaman的方法应用于不保持迹的原始幺正Schwarz映射，因为并非所有此类映射都保持迹。
AI.method: 应用Rahaman的方法来处理不保持迹的原始幺正Schwarz映射。
AI.result: 1. 任何原始幺正Schwarz映射的本原性指数至多为 $2(D-1)^2$。 2. 任何原始2-正映射（特别是任意原始完全正映射）的本原性指数至多为 $2(D-1)^2$。
AI.conclusion: 证明了任何原始幺正Schwarz映射的本原性指数的界限为 $2(D-1)^2$，扩展了先前仅限于保持迹映射的结果。该界限特别适用于原始完全正映射，并与Perez-Garcia等人的一个猜想相关。
AI.translation: 在本注记中，我们证明了任何原始幺正Schwarz映射的本原性指数至多为 $2(D-1)^2$，其中 $D$ 是底层矩阵代数的维数。该不等式最初由Rahaman针对既是幺正又保持迹的Schwarz映射证明。正如我们所示，幺正性的假设基本上是无害的，但通常并非所有原始幺正Schwarz映射都保持迹。因此，本注记的精确目的是展示如何将Rahaman的方法应用于不保持迹的原始幺正Schwarz映射。作为该定理的一个推论，我们证明了任何原始2-正映射的本原性指数至多为 $2(D-1)^2$，因此该界限特别适用于任意原始完全正映射。我们简要讨论了这与Perez-Garcia、Verstraete、Wolf和Cirac的一个猜想的关系。
AI.summary: 本文确定了任何原始幺正Schwarz映射的本原性指数的上限为 $2(D-1)^2$，推广了Rahaman先前对保持迹映射的证明结果。本文的核心在于展示了如何在缺乏保持迹的条件下应用Rahaman的方法。该界限同样适用于原始2-正映射和完全正映射，并简要讨论了其与一个现有猜想的关系。
AI.keywords: 量子Wielandt不等式, 本原性指数, Schwarz映射, 完全正映射, 幺正映射
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功地将一个已知的紧界（与量子Wielandt不等式相关）从一类受限的量子通道（幺正且保持迹）扩展到更广泛但仍然重要的类别（幺正Schwarz映射）。通过证明保持迹的条件对于该界限的成立并非必需，本文增强了该界限在量子信息理论中的适用性，特别是对于分析原始量子动力学系统的混合时间。与Perez-Garcia等人的猜想的关联表明该结果与该领域的开放性问题相关。

title: FE-MCFormer: An interpretable fault diagnosis framework for rotating machinery under strong noise based on time-frequency fusion transformer
summary: Many fault diagnosis methods of rotating machines are based on discriminative features extracted from signals collected from the key components such as bearings. However, under complex operating conditions, periodic impulsive characteristics in the signal related to weak fault information are often obscured by noise interference. Consequently, existing approaches struggle to learn interpretable fault-related features in such scenarios. This paper proposes a novel transformer framework (FE-MCFormer) to extract interpretable time-frequency features, with the aim of improving the fault detection accuracy and intrepretability of rotating machines under strong noise. First, a Fourier adaptive reconstruction embedding layer is introduced as a global information encoder in the model. Subsequently, a time-frequency fusion module is designed, further improve the model robustness and interpretability. The effectiveness of FE-MCFormer in machine fault diagnosis is validated through three case studies.

AI.title_translation: FE-MCFormer：一种基于时频融合Transformer的强噪声下旋转机械可解释故障诊断框架
AI.tldr: 提出FE-MCFormer，一种基于时频融合Transformer的新型可解释故障诊断框架，通过傅里叶自适应重建嵌入层和时频融合模块，解决了强噪声环境下旋转机械故障特征难以提取且缺乏可解释性的问题，旨在提高诊断准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 在复杂工况下，与微弱故障信息相关的周期性冲击特征常被强噪声干扰掩盖，导致现有方法难以学习可解释的故障相关特征，影响故障检测准确性。
AI.method: 提出FE-MCFormer框架。首先，引入傅里叶自适应重建嵌入层作为全局信息编码器；其次，设计了一个时频融合模块，以进一步提高模型的鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.result: 通过三个案例研究验证了FE-MCFormer在机械故障诊断中的有效性。
AI.translation: 许多旋转机械的故障诊断方法基于从轴承等关键部件收集的信号中提取的判别性特征。然而，在复杂的运行条件下，信号中与微弱故障信息相关的周期性冲击特性常常被噪声干扰所掩盖。因此，现有方法在此类场景中难以学习可解释的故障相关特征。本文提出了一种新型Transformer框架（FE-MCFormer）来提取可解释的时频特征，旨在提高强噪声下旋转机械的故障检测精度和可解释性。首先，模型中引入了傅里叶自适应重建嵌入层作为全局信息编码器。随后，设计了一个时频融合模块，进一步提高了模型的鲁棒性和可解释性。通过三个案例研究验证了FE-MCFormer在机械故障诊断中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FE-MCFormer，一种用于旋转机械故障诊断的新型Transformer框架，以解决现有方法在强噪声环境下难以提取可解释故障特征的问题。该框架通过引入傅里叶自适应重建嵌入层进行全局信息编码，并设计时频融合模块，旨在提高模型的鲁棒性、可解释性和故障检测准确性。该框架的有效性已通过三个案例研究得到验证。
AI.keywords: 旋转机械故障诊断, Transformer, 时频融合, 强噪声, 可解释性
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将Transformer架构应用于强噪声环境下的旋转机械故障诊断，并特别关注“可解释性”这一关键特性。通过结合傅里叶自适应重建和时频融合模块，该模型试图在保留信号全局信息的同时，增强对噪声的鲁棒性，从而有效提取被噪声掩盖的微弱故障特征。在工业应用中，强噪声环境下的鲁棒性和模型可解释性对于实际部署至关重要，因此该框架具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Beyond Basic A/B testing: Improving Statistical Efficiency for Business Growth
summary: The standard A/B testing approaches are mostly based on t-test in large scale industry applications. These standard approaches however suffers from low statistical power in business settings, due to nature of small sample-size or non-Gaussian distribution or return-on-investment (ROI) consideration. In this paper, we (i) show the statistical efficiency of using estimating equation and U statistics, which can address these issues separately; and (ii) propose a novel doubly robust generalized U that allows flexible definition of treatment effect, and can handles small samples, distribution robustness, ROI and confounding consideration in one framework. We provide theoretical results on asymptotics and efficiency bounds, together with insights on the efficiency gain from theoretical analysis. We further conduct comprehensive simulation studies, apply the methods to multiple real A/B tests at a large SaaS company, and share results and learnings that are broadly useful.

AI.title_translation: 超越基础A/B测试：提高统计效率以促进业务增长
AI.tldr: 针对传统A/B测试在小样本、非高斯分布和ROI考量下的统计功效不足问题，本文提出了一种新颖的“双重鲁棒广义U统计量”（doubly robust generalized U），该方法在一个框架内同时解决了样本小、分布鲁棒性、ROI和混杂因素等问题，并通过理论分析、模拟和真实SaaS公司数据进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于t检验的标准A/B测试方法在实际业务应用中统计功效低下，原因在于样本量小、数据分布非高斯或需要考虑投资回报率（ROI）等因素。
AI.method: 1. 展示了使用估计方程和U统计量分别解决现有问题的统计效率。2. 提出了一种新颖的“双重鲁棒广义U统计量”（doubly robust generalized U），该方法允许灵活定义处理效应，并在一个统一框架内处理小样本、分布鲁棒性、ROI和混杂因素。3. 提供了关于渐近性和效率界限的理论结果。
AI.result: 进行了全面的模拟研究，并将所提方法应用于一家大型SaaS公司的多个真实A/B测试中。分享了具有广泛实用价值的结果和经验教训。
AI.translation: 在进行大规模工业应用时，标准的A/B测试方法大多基于t检验。然而，由于小样本量、非高斯分布或投资回报率（ROI）的考量，这些标准方法在业务环境中统计功效低下。在本文中，我们（i）展示了使用估计方程和U统计量在分别解决这些问题时的统计效率；（ii）提出了一种新颖的双重鲁棒广义U统计量（doubly robust generalized U），它允许灵活定义处理效应，并能在一个框架内处理小样本、分布鲁棒性、ROI和混杂因素。我们提供了关于渐近性和效率界限的理论结果，以及理论分析带来的效率增益洞察。我们进一步进行了全面的模拟研究，将这些方法应用于一家大型SaaS公司的多个真实A/B测试，并分享了具有广泛实用价值的结果和经验教训。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决传统A/B测试（基于t检验）在商业应用中因小样本、非高斯分布和ROI考量导致的统计功效不足问题。作者首先探讨了估计方程和U统计量的效率，随后提出了一种创新的“双重鲁棒广义U统计量”。该统计量在一个统一的框架内全面解决了小样本、分布鲁棒性、ROI和混杂因素等挑战，并提供了理论上的渐近性和效率界限证明。通过全面的模拟和对一家大型SaaS公司真实A/B测试的应用，证明了该方法在提高业务增长统计效率方面的实用性和有效性。
AI.keywords: A/B测试, 统计效率, U统计量, 双重鲁棒性, 业务增长
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了工业界A/B测试中的一个核心痛点：标准t检验在面对复杂现实数据（如小样本、非正态、关注ROI而非均值）时的低效和不可靠性。其创新点在于提出了“双重鲁棒广义U统计量”（doubly robust generalized U），这是一个强大的统一框架，能够同时处理小样本、分布鲁棒性、ROI考量和混杂因素等多个统计难题。这种结合了因果推断（双重鲁棒性）和非参数统计（U统计量）的方法，对于需要高统计效率和稳健性的商业决策至关重要，是推动A/B测试从基础统计工具走向复杂因果分析的重要一步。

title: AI-Informed Model Analogs for Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Prediction
summary: Subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasting is crucial for public health, disaster preparedness, and agriculture, and yet it remains a particularly challenging timescale to predict. We explore the use of an interpretable AI-informed model analog forecasting approach, previously employed on longer timescales, to improve S2S predictions. Using an artificial neural network, we learn a mask of weights to optimize analog selection and showcase its versatility across three varied prediction tasks: 1) classification of Week 3-4 Southern California summer temperatures; 2) regional regression of Month 1 midwestern U.S. summer temperatures; and 3) classification of Month 1-2 North Atlantic wintertime upper atmospheric winds. The AI-informed analogs outperform traditional analog forecasting approaches, as well as climatology and persistence baselines, for deterministic and probabilistic skill metrics on both climate model and reanalysis data. We find the analog ensembles built using the AI-informed approach also produce better predictions of temperature extremes and improve representation of forecast uncertainty. Finally, by using an interpretable-AI framework, we analyze the learned masks of weights to better understand S2S sources of predictability.

AI.title_translation: AI辅助的模型类比方法用于次季节至季节预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的AI（使用ANN学习权重掩码）增强的模型类比方法，显著提高了次季节至季节（S2S）预测的准确性，超越了传统方法和基线，并能更好地预测极端事件和不确定性。
AI.motivation: 次季节至季节（S2S）预测对于公共卫生、备灾和农业至关重要，但该时间尺度上的预测极具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用可解释的AI辅助的模型类比预测方法。具体是通过人工神经网络（ANN）学习一个权重掩码来优化类比选择。该方法应用于三个不同的预测任务（南加州温度分类、中西部温度回归、北大西洋风速分类）。
AI.result: AI辅助的类比方法在确定性和概率性技能指标上，均优于传统的类比预测方法以及气候学和持续性基线。此外，该方法构建的类比集合能更好地预测极端温度，并改善了预报不确定性的表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析学习到的权重掩码，该方法不仅提高了预测性能，还有助于理解S2S可预测性的来源。
AI.translation: 次季节至季节（S2S）预报对于公共卫生、备灾和农业至关重要，但它仍然是一个特别具有挑战性的预测时间尺度。我们探索使用一种可解释的、AI辅助的模型类比预报方法（该方法此前已应用于更长的时间尺度）来改进S2S预测。我们使用人工神经网络学习一个权重掩码以优化类比选择，并展示了其在三个不同预测任务中的多功能性：1) 第3-4周南加州夏季温度分类；2) 第1个月美国中西部夏季温度区域回归；3) 第1-2个月北大西洋冬季高层大气风分类。在气候模型和再分析数据上，AI辅助的类比方法在确定性和概率性技能指标方面均优于传统的类比预报方法以及气候学和持续性基线。我们发现，使用AI辅助方法构建的类比集合还能更好地预测极端温度，并改善了预报不确定性的表示。最后，通过使用可解释的AI框架，我们分析了学习到的权重掩码，以更好地理解S2S可预测性的来源。
AI.summary: 本文提出并验证了一种基于人工神经网络（ANN）的可解释AI辅助模型类比方法，用于解决极具挑战性的次季节至季节（S2S）预测问题。通过学习优化类比选择的权重掩码，该方法在三个不同的温度和风速预测任务中，其确定性和概率性预报技能均显著优于传统类比方法和基线。此外，该方法改进了极端事件的预测和预报不确定性的表示，并通过分析学习到的权重，提供了对S2S可预测性来源的洞察。
AI.keywords: 次季节至季节预测, 模型类比, 人工智能, 可解释性, 权重掩码
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将可解释的AI（通过ANN学习权重）与传统的模型类比方法相结合，优化了类比选择过程，从而在关键但困难的S2S时间尺度上实现了性能的显著提升。其重要性在于，不仅提供了更准确的预测结果（包括极端事件），还通过可解释性分析（分析权重掩码）为气候科学界理解S2S可预测性的物理机制提供了新的工具和线索。摘要中未提及具体的限制，但模型类比方法的性能通常依赖于历史数据的质量和覆盖范围。

title: Efficient Gate Reordering for Distributed Quantum Compiling in Data Centers
summary: Just as classical computing relies on distributed systems, the quantum computing era requires new kinds of infrastructure and software tools. Quantum networks will become the backbone of hybrid, quantum-augmented data centers, in which quantum algorithms are distributed over a local network of quantum processing units (QPUs) interconnected via shared entanglement. In this context, it is crucial to develop methods and software that minimize the number of inter-QPU communications. Here we describe key features of the quantum compiler araQne, which is designed to minimize distribution cost, measured by the number of entangled pairs required to distribute a monolithic quantum circuit using gate teleportation protocols. We establish the crucial role played by circuit reordering strategies, which strongly reduce the distribution cost compared to a baseline approach.

AI.title_translation: 数据中心分布式量子编译的高效门重排序
AI.tldr: araQne编译器通过高效的门重排序，显著减少了在数据中心分布式QPU上编译量子电路所需的通信成本（纠缠对数量）。
AI.motivation: 随着量子计算时代的到来，需要新的基础设施和软件工具来支持量子增强型数据中心。在这些数据中心中，量子算法分布式运行于互连的QPU上，因此开发最小化QPU间通信（即分发成本）的方法至关重要。
AI.method: 描述了量子编译器araQne的关键特性。该编译器旨在通过使用门隐形传态协议最小化分发成本（以所需纠缠对的数量衡量）。核心方法是采用电路重排序策略。
AI.result: 与基线方法相比，电路重排序策略能够显著降低分发成本。
AI.conclusion: 电路重排序策略在最小化分布式量子编译的分发成本方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
AI.translation: 正如经典计算依赖于分布式系统一样，量子计算时代需要新型的基础设施和软件工具。量子网络将成为混合型、量子增强型数据中心的骨干，在其中，量子算法通过共享纠缠在本地网络互连的量子处理单元（QPU）上进行分发。在这种背景下，开发能够最小化QPU间通信数量的方法和软件至关重要。本文描述了量子编译器araQne的关键特性，该编译器旨在最小化分发成本，分发成本通过使用门隐形传态协议分发一个整体量子电路所需的纠缠对数量来衡量。我们确立了电路重排序策略所发挥的关键作用，与基线方法相比，这些策略能够极大地降低分发成本。
AI.summary: 鉴于分布式量子计算基础设施的需求，本文介绍了一种量子编译器araQne。该编译器专为最小化分发成本而设计，分发成本通过使用门隐形传态协议在互连的量子处理器单元（QPU）上分发大型量子电路所需的纠缠对数量来衡量。研究表明，采用电路重排序策略可以显著降低分发成本。
AI.keywords: 量子编译, 门重排序, 分布式系统, 量子数据中心, araQne
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将经典分布式系统的概念引入量子计算，提出了量子增强型数据中心的基础设施需求。其重要性在于，通过引入araQne编译器和门重排序策略，解决了分布式量子计算中关键的实际瓶颈——QPU间通信成本问题。这表明软件编译层面的优化对于实现可扩展的分布式量子硬件至关重要，并提供了一个明确的、以纠缠对数量衡量的成本指标。

title: Long-Duration Station-Keeping Strategy for Cislunar Spacecraft Formations
summary: This paper demonstrates a novel guidance and control strategy for cislunar near-rectilinear halo orbit formation-keeping applied to high-fidelity dynamics. Bounded relative motion is constructed about long-duration ephemeris trajectories with osculating invariant circles to form quasi-periodic relative orbits. State-of-the-art absolute control strategies are paired with a simple and effective relative control feedback law. Finally, a control barrier function is implemented to ensure recursively passively-safe bounded relative motion under feedback in the presence of possible missed maneuver events for the duration of the formation flight. The strategy is verified in high-fidelity simulation environments through Monte Carlo trials.

AI.title_translation: 环月空间航天器编队的长时间定点保持策略
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于环月NRHO编队的制导和控制策略，该策略结合了相对运动构造、绝对/相对控制律和控制势垒函数（CBF），以确保在高保真动态环境中长时间保持安全且有界的相对运动。
AI.motivation: 实现环月近直线晕轨道（NRHO）编队的长时间定点保持，并应用于高保真动力学模型。
AI.method: 1. 利用长时间星历轨迹和密切不变圆构造准周期性的有界相对运动。2. 将最先进的绝对控制策略与简单有效的相对控制反馈律相结合。3. 引入控制势垒函数（CBF）来确保在编队飞行期间，即使出现机动失败事件，也能实现递归被动安全的有界相对运动。
AI.result: 该策略通过高保真模拟环境中的蒙特卡洛试验得到了验证。
AI.translation: 本文展示了一种应用于高保真动力学的环月近直线晕轨道编队保持的新型制导与控制策略。利用长时间星历轨迹和密切不变圆构造有界相对运动，形成准周期性的相对轨道。将最先进的绝对控制策略与一种简单有效的相对控制反馈律相结合。最后，实施了一个控制势垒函数，以确保在编队飞行期间，即使在可能错过机动事件的情况下，反馈也能实现递归被动安全且有界的相对运动。该策略通过高保真模拟环境中的蒙特卡洛试验得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对环月近直线晕轨道（NRHO）航天器编队保持的制导与控制策略。该策略通过结合基于密切不变圆的准周期相对运动构造、先进的绝对控制与相对反馈控制律，并辅以控制势垒函数（CBF）进行安全保障，确保在高保真动态环境中长时间维持安全且有界的相对运动。
AI.keywords: 环月, 编队保持, 近直线晕轨道, 控制势垒函数, 相对运动
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将多种先进的控制和动力学工具集成到一个鲁棒的编队保持策略中。特别值得注意的是，使用密切不变圆来构造准周期相对轨道，以及引入控制势垒函数（CBF）来解决实际操作中可能遇到的“机动失败”问题，极大地增强了策略的鲁棒性和安全性，这对于深空长时间任务至关重要。

title: Trustworthy scientific inference with generative models
summary: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) excels at producing complex data structures (text, images, videos) by learning patterns from training examples. Across scientific disciplines, researchers are now applying generative models to "inverse problems" to directly predict hidden parameters from observed data along with measures of uncertainty. While these predictive or posterior-based methods can handle intractable likelihoods and large-scale studies, they can also produce biased or overconfident conclusions even without model misspecifications. We present a solution with Frequentist-Bayes (FreB), a mathematically rigorous protocol that reshapes AI-generated posterior probability distributions into (locally valid) confidence regions that consistently include true parameters with the expected probability, while achieving minimum size when training and target data align. We demonstrate FreB's effectiveness by tackling diverse case studies in the physical sciences: identifying unknown sources under dataset shift, reconciling competing theoretical models, and mitigating selection bias and systematics in observational studies. By providing validity guarantees with interpretable diagnostics, FreB enables trustworthy scientific inference across fields where direct likelihood evaluation remains impossible or prohibitively expensive.

AI.title_translation: 基于生成模型的可靠科学推断
AI.tldr: 生成模型在科学推断中可能产生偏差。本文提出了 Frequentist-Bayes (FreB) 协议，将生成模型的后验分布转换为具有有效性保证的置信区域，实现了可靠的科学推断，尤其适用于似然函数难以计算的领域。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于生成模型的科学推断（应用于逆问题）可以处理难解的似然函数和大规模研究，但即使模型没有错误设定，也可能产生有偏见或过于自信的结论。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 Frequentist-Bayes (FreB) 的数学严谨协议。该协议将 AI 生成的后验概率分布重塑为（局部有效的）置信区域，使其能以预期的概率持续包含真实参数，并在训练和目标数据一致时达到最小尺寸。
AI.result: 通过解决物理科学中的各种案例研究证明了 FreB 的有效性：包括在数据集偏移下识别未知来源、调和相互竞争的理论模型，以及减轻观测研究中的选择偏差和系统误差。
AI.conclusion: FreB 通过提供有效性保证和可解释的诊断，使得在无法进行或成本过高的直接似然评估领域中，实现可靠的科学推断成为可能。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能 (AI) 通过从训练示例中学习模式，擅长生成复杂的数据结构（文本、图像、视频）。在各个科学学科中，研究人员现在正将生成模型应用于“逆问题”，以根据观测数据直接预测隐藏参数，并提供不确定性度量。虽然这些基于预测或后验的方法可以处理难解的似然函数和大规模研究，但即使没有模型错误设定，它们也可能产生有偏见或过于自信的结论。我们提出了一个解决方案：Frequentist-Bayes (FreB)，这是一个数学上严谨的协议，它将 AI 生成的后验概率分布重塑为（局部有效的）置信区域，使其能以预期的概率持续包含真实参数，同时在训练和目标数据一致时实现最小尺寸。我们通过解决物理科学中的各种案例研究来证明 FreB 的有效性：包括在数据集偏移下识别未知来源、调和相互竞争的理论模型，以及减轻观测研究中的选择偏差和系统误差。通过提供具有可解释诊断的有效性保证，FreB 使得在直接似然评估仍然不可能或成本过高的领域中，实现可靠的科学推断成为可能。
AI.summary: 鉴于生成模型在科学逆问题推断中可能导致有偏或过度自信的结论，本文提出了 Frequentist-Bayes (FreB) 协议。FreB 是一种数学上严谨的方法，它将 AI 生成的后验分布重塑为具有频率派有效性保证的置信区域，确保了对真实参数的可靠包含。研究通过物理科学中的案例（如处理数据集偏移和减轻偏差）证明了 FreB 的有效性，从而在难以直接计算似然函数的科学领域中实现了可信赖的推断。
AI.keywords: 生成模型, 科学推断, 逆问题, 频率派-贝叶斯, 不确定性量化
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于提出了 FreB 协议，解决了生成模型在科学推断中普遍存在的偏差和过度自信问题。它巧妙地将 AI 生成的后验分布（贝叶斯结果）与频率派的有效性保证（置信区域）结合起来，确保了推断结果的统计可靠性。这一点至关重要，因为它使得生成模型能够在似然函数难以计算的复杂科学领域（如物理科学）中提供可信赖、可解释的诊断和不确定性量化，极大地提高了 AI 在科学发现中的实用性和可靠性。

title: Bellman Optimality of Average-Reward Robust Markov Decision Processes with a Constant Gain
summary: Learning and optimal control under robust Markov decision processes (MDPs) have received increasing attention, yet most existing theory, algorithms, and applications focus on finite-horizon or discounted models. Long-run average-reward formulations, while natural in many operations research and management contexts, remain underexplored. This is primarily because the dynamic programming foundations are technically challenging and only partially understood, with several fundamental questions remaining open. This paper steps toward a general framework for average-reward robust MDPs by analyzing the constant-gain setting. We study the average-reward robust control problem with possible information asymmetries between the controller and an S-rectangular adversary. Our analysis centers on the constant-gain robust Bellman equation, examining both the existence of solutions and their relationship to the optimal average reward. Specifically, we identify when solutions to the robust Bellman equation characterize the optimal average reward and stationary policies, and we provide one-sided weak communication conditions ensuring solutions' existence. These findings expand the dynamic programming theory for average-reward robust MDPs and lay a foundation for robust dynamic decision making under long-run average criteria in operational environments.

AI.title_translation: 平均回报鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程的常数增益下贝尔曼最优性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了平均回报鲁棒MDP的常数增益设置，分析了鲁棒贝尔曼方程的解及其与最优平均回报的关系，并给出了存在性条件，为长期平均标准下的鲁棒动态决策奠定了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有的鲁棒MDP理论、算法和应用主要集中在有限时间或折扣模型。长期平均回报公式在许多运营研究和管理环境中很自然，但尚未得到充分探索，因为其动态规划基础在技术上具有挑战性且理解不完全，仍有基本问题悬而未决。
AI.method: 通过分析常数增益设置，研究平均回报鲁棒控制问题，考虑控制器和S-矩形对手之间可能的信息不对称。核心是研究常数增益鲁棒贝尔曼方程的解的存在性及其与最优平均回报的关系。
AI.result: 确定了鲁棒贝尔曼方程的解何时能够表征最优平均回报和稳定策略。提供了确保解存在性的单边弱通信条件。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现扩展了平均回报鲁棒MDP的动态规划理论，并为运营环境中长期平均标准下的鲁棒动态决策奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 在鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）下的学习和最优控制已受到越来越多的关注，但现有的大多数理论、算法和应用都集中在有限时间或折扣模型上。长期平均回报的公式，虽然在许多运营研究和管理环境中是自然的，但仍未得到充分探索。这主要是因为动态规划基础在技术上具有挑战性，并且只被部分理解，仍有几个基本问题悬而未决。本文通过分析常数增益设置，向平均回报鲁棒MDPs的通用框架迈进。我们研究了平均回报鲁棒控制问题，其中控制器和S-矩形对手之间可能存在信息不对称。我们的分析围绕常数增益鲁棒贝尔曼方程展开，考察了其解的存在性及其与最优平均回报的关系。具体来说，我们确定了鲁棒贝尔曼方程的解何时能够表征最优平均回报和稳定策略，并提供了确保解存在性的单边弱通信条件。这些发现扩展了平均回报鲁棒MDP的动态规划理论，并为运营环境中长期平均标准下的鲁棒动态决策奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文致力于解决长期平均回报鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDPs）理论不足的问题。通过研究常数增益设置下的鲁棒贝尔曼方程，本文分析了其解的存在性以及与最优平均回报和稳定策略的关系，并提出了确保解存在的单边弱通信条件。该工作扩展了平均回报鲁棒MDP的动态规划理论，为长期鲁棒决策提供了理论基础。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程, 平均回报, 贝尔曼方程, 常数增益, 动态规划
AI.comments:
**创新性：** 论文通过关注“常数增益”设置，解决了平均回报鲁棒MDP领域中一个技术上具有挑战性和未被充分探索的领域。它首次系统地分析了常数增益鲁棒贝尔曼方程，弥补了现有理论主要集中在有限或折扣模型的空白。
**重要性：** 建立长期平均回报下的鲁棒动态规划基础，对于需要长期稳定控制（如运营研究和管理）的应用至关重要。
**局限性（基于摘要的推测）：** 摘要只提到了“常数增益”设置，这可能意味着其结果的普适性尚未覆盖更一般的平均回报鲁棒MDP框架。同时，它只提供了理论基础（贝尔曼最优性和存在条件），并未提及具体的算法或数值实现。

title: Stokes' theorem as an entropy-extremizing duality
summary: Given a manifold $\mathcal{M} \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, we consider all codimension-1 submanifolds of $\mathcal{M}$ that satisfy the generalized Stokes' theorem and show that $\partial\mathcal{M}$ uniquely maximizes the associated entropy functional. This provides an information theoretic characterization of the duality expressed by Stokes' theorem, whereby a manifold's boundary is its 'least informative' subset satisfying the Stokes relation.

AI.title_translation: 斯托克斯定理作为熵极值对偶性
AI.tldr: 斯托克斯定理的对偶性可以用信息论来解释：流形边界是唯一能最大化相关熵泛函的子集，因此它是“信息量最少”的部分。
AI.motivation: 为斯托克斯定理所表达的对偶性提供一个信息论的刻画。
AI.method: 考察满足广义斯托克斯定理的流形$\mathcal{M}$的所有余维-1子流形，并分析相关的熵泛函，以确定哪个子集能使该泛函达到极值。
AI.result: 流形的边界 ($\partial\mathcal{M}$) 唯一地最大化了相关的熵泛函。这表明边界是满足斯托克斯关系的“信息量最少”的子集。
AI.conclusion: 斯托克斯定理表达了一种对偶性，可以通过信息论进行刻画，其中流形的边界是唯一能最大化相关熵泛函（即“信息量最少”）的子集。
AI.translation: 考虑到一个流形 $\mathcal{M} \subset \mathbb{R}^n$，我们考察所有满足广义斯托克斯定理的 $\mathcal{M}$ 的余维-1子流形，并证明 $\partial\mathcal{M}$ 唯一地最大化了相关的熵泛函。这为斯托克斯定理所表达的对偶性提供了一个信息论的刻画，即流形的边界是满足斯托克斯关系的“信息量最少”的子集。
AI.summary: 本文利用信息论来刻画斯托克斯定理的对偶性。作者分析了满足广义斯托克斯关系的余维-1子流形，证明了流形的边界 ($\partial\mathcal{M}$) 是唯一能最大化相关熵泛函的实体，从而将其定义为满足斯托克斯关系的“信息量最少”的子集。
AI.keywords: 斯托克斯定理, 熵泛函, 对偶性, 信息论, 流形边界
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将微分几何（斯托克斯定理）与信息论（熵泛函）联系起来。这种跨学科的视角为斯托克斯定理所表达的基本数学对偶性提供了一种新颖的、基于信息论的解释。通过证明边界是唯一的熵最大化子集，该工作提供了一种量化和理解几何边界“信息量”的新方法，具有重要的理论意义。摘要中未提及具体熵泛函的形式或其在物理学中的潜在应用。

title: Optimizing the non-Clifford-count in unitary synthesis using Reinforcement Learning
comments: Added results on asymptotic T-count estimates
summary: In this paper we study the potential of using reinforcement learning (RL) in order to synthesize quantum circuits, while optimizing the T-count and CS-count, of unitaries that are exactly implementable by the Clifford+T and Clifford+CS gate sets, respectively. We have designed our RL framework to work with channel representation of unitaries, that enables us to perform matrix operations efficiently, using integers only. We have also incorporated pruning heuristics and a canonicalization of operators, in order to reduce the search complexity. As a result, compared to previous works, we are able to implement significantly larger unitaries, in less time, with much better success rate and improvement factor. Our results for Clifford+T synthesis on two qubit unitaries achieve close-to-optimal decompositions for up to 100 T gates, 5 times more than previous RL algorithms and to the best of our knowledge, the largest instances achieved with any method to date. Our RL algorithm is able to recover previously-known optimal linear complexity algorithm for T-count-optimal decomposition of 1 qubit unitaries. We illustrate significant reduction in the asymptotic T-count estimate of important primitives like controlled cyclic shift (43%), controlled adder (14.3%) and multiplier (14%), without adding any extra ancilla. For 2-qubit Clifford+CS unitaries, our algorithm achieves a linear complexity, something that could only be accomplished by a previous algorithm using SO(6) representation.
comment: Added results on asymptotic T-count estimates

AI.title_translation: 使用强化学习优化酉合成中的非Clifford门计数
AI.tldr: 本文利用强化学习优化量子电路合成中酉算子的T门和CS门计数，实现了更大规模、更高效且T门计数更优的分解。
AI.motivation: 在量子电路合成中，优化酉算子的T门计数和CS门计数。
AI.method: 设计了一个强化学习（RL）框架，使用酉算子的通道表示，通过纯整数实现高效矩阵运算。结合剪枝启发式算法和算子规范化来降低搜索复杂性。
AI.result: 与现有工作相比，能够更快地合成显著更大的酉算子，具有更好的成功率和改进因子。对于两量子比特酉算子的Clifford+T合成，实现了高达100个T门的接近最优分解，是之前RL算法的5倍，也是迄今为止任何方法实现的最大实例。RL算法能够恢复已知的一量子比特酉算子T门计数最优分解的线性复杂度算法。显著降低了受控循环移位（43%）、受控加法器（14.3%）和乘法器（14%）等重要原语的渐近T门计数估计，且无需额外辅助比特。对于双量子比特Clifford+CS酉算子，算法实现了线性复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习在量子电路合成中，特别是在优化非Clifford门计数方面，显示出显著的潜力，能够处理更大规模的酉算子，并取得接近最优的分解结果，甚至在某些情况下超越现有技术。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了使用强化学习（RL）合成量子电路的潜力，同时优化分别可通过Clifford+T和Clifford+CS门集精确实现的酉算子的T门计数和CS门计数。我们设计的RL框架采用酉算子的通道表示，这使得我们能够仅使用整数高效地执行矩阵运算。我们还结合了剪枝启发式算法和算子的规范化，以减少搜索复杂性。因此，与之前的工作相比，我们能够以更少的时间、更高的成功率和改进因子实现显著更大的酉算子。我们对双量子比特酉算子的Clifford+T合成结果实现了高达100个T门的接近最优分解，是之前RL算法的5倍，并且据我们所知，这是迄今为止任何方法所能达到的最大实例。我们的RL算法能够恢复已知的一量子比特酉算子T门计数最优分解的线性复杂度算法。我们展示了受控循环移位（43%）、受控加法器（14.3%）和乘法器（14%）等重要原语的渐近T门计数估计显著降低，且无需添加任何额外辅助比特。对于双量子比特Clifford+CS酉算子，我们的算法实现了线性复杂度，这在以前只能通过使用SO(6)表示的算法实现。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用强化学习（RL）优化量子电路合成中酉算子的T门和CS门计数。研究人员设计了一个基于通道表示的RL框架，结合剪枝启发式算法和算子规范化来降低搜索复杂性。实验结果表明，该方法能够高效地合成比现有工作大得多的酉算子，并在两量子比特Clifford+T合成中实现了高达100个T门的接近最优分解，显著降低了关键原语的T门计数，并在Clifford+CS合成中达到了线性复杂度。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 量子电路合成, T门计数, CS门计数, 酉算子
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地将强化学习应用于量子电路合成，特别是在优化非Clifford门计数方面取得了显著进展。通过采用通道表示和搜索空间优化技术，克服了现有RL算法在处理大规模酉算子时的局限性，实现了更大规模、更高效且T门计数更优的分解。其成果在实际量子计算中具有重要意义，尤其是在降低量子算法的资源消耗方面。

title: Token Is All You Price
summary: We build a mechanism design framework where a platform designs GenAI models to screen users who obtain instrumental value from the generated conversation and privately differ in their preference for latency. We show that the revenue-optimal mechanism is simple: deploy a single aligned (user-optimal) model and use token cap as the only instrument to screen the user. The design decouples model training from pricing, is readily implemented with token metering, and mitigates misalignment pressures.

AI.tldr: 一个收入最优的生成式AI平台定价机制仅使用一个用户对齐的模型，并通过令牌上限来筛选用户，实现了模型训练与定价的解耦。
AI.motivation: 平台需要设计生成式AI模型来筛选用户，这些用户从生成的对话中获得工具性价值，并且在对延迟的偏好上存在私人差异。
AI.method: 构建了一个机制设计框架。
AI.result: 收入最优机制很简单：部署一个单一的对齐（用户最优）模型，并使用令牌上限作为筛选用户的唯一工具。这种设计将模型训练与定价解耦，易于通过令牌计量实现，并减轻了模型错位压力。
AI.conclusion: 收入最优机制是部署单一对齐（用户最优）模型，并仅使用令牌上限进行筛选，这实现了训练与定价的解耦，易于实施，并减轻了模型错位压力。
AI.translation: 我们建立了一个机制设计框架，其中一个平台设计生成式AI模型来筛选那些从生成的对话中获得工具性价值，并且在对延迟的偏好上存在私人差异的用户。我们表明，收入最优机制很简单：部署一个单一的对齐（用户最优）模型，并使用令牌上限作为筛选用户的唯一工具。该设计将模型训练与定价解耦，易于通过令牌计量实现，并减轻了错位压力。
AI.summary: 本文建立了一个机制设计框架，用于平台设计生成式AI模型并筛选对延迟偏好不同的用户。研究表明，收入最优机制非常简单：部署一个单一的用户最优模型，并仅使用令牌上限作为筛选用户的工具。这种设计将模型训练与定价分离，易于通过令牌计量实现，并能减轻模型错位问题。
AI.keywords: 机制设计, 生成式AI, 令牌上限, 定价, 延迟
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于，为生成式AI服务提供了一种简单且理论上收入最优的定价机制（令牌上限）。该机制成功地处理了用户的异质性（对延迟的偏好），同时带来了实际益处，例如将训练与定价解耦，简化了实施，并减轻了模型错位压力。

title: Same model, better performance: the impact of shuffling on DNA Language Models benchmarking
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly popular in genomics due to their potential to decode complex biological sequences. Hence, researchers require a standardized benchmark to evaluate DNA Language Models (DNA LMs) capabilities. However, evaluating DNA LMs is a complex task that intersects genomic's domain-specific challenges and machine learning methodologies, where seemingly minor implementation details can significantly compromise benchmark validity. We demonstrate this through BEND (Benchmarking DNA Language Models), where hardware-dependent hyperparameters -- number of data loading workers and buffer sizes -- create spurious performance variations of up to 4% for identical models. The problem stems from inadequate data shuffling interacting with domain specific data characteristics. Experiments with three DNA language models (HyenaDNA, DNABERT-2, ResNet-LM) show these artifacts affect both absolute performance and relative model rankings. We propose a simple solution: pre-shuffling data before storage eliminates hardware dependencies while maintaining efficiency. This work highlights how standard ML practices can interact unexpectedly with domain-specific data characteristics, with broader implications for benchmark design in specialized domains.

AI.title_translation: 相同的模型，更好的性能：数据混洗对DNA语言模型基准测试的影响
AI.tldr: DNA语言模型基准测试中，硬件依赖的数据加载参数与数据混洗不足相互作用，可导致高达4%的虚假性能波动并影响模型排名。解决方案是：在数据存储前进行预混洗，以消除硬件依赖并保证评估的有效性。
AI.motivation: 研究人员需要一个标准化的基准来评估DNA语言模型的能力。然而，当前的评估很复杂，且细微的实现细节（如不充分的数据混洗）会导致基准测试有效性受到损害，产生虚假的性能波动。
AI.method: 通过BEND（DNA语言模型基准测试）平台进行演示，证明硬件依赖的超参数（数据加载工作线程数和缓冲区大小）会导致相同模型产生性能波动。使用三种DNA语言模型（HyenaDNA、DNABERT-2、ResNet-LM）进行实验。提出解决方案：在数据存储前进行预混洗。
AI.result: 由于不充分的数据混洗，相同的模型出现了高达4%的虚假性能波动。这些假象影响了模型的绝对性能和相对排名。提出的预混洗方案消除了硬件依赖，同时保持了效率。
AI.conclusion: 标准的机器学习实践可能会与特定领域的数据特征产生意想不到的相互作用，这对专业领域的基准测试设计具有更广泛的影响。在数据存储前进行预混洗是解决DNA语言模型基准测试中硬件依赖问题的简单有效方案。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型因其解码复杂生物序列的潜力而在基因组学中越来越受欢迎。因此，研究人员需要一个标准化的基准来评估DNA语言模型（DNA LMs）的能力。然而，评估DNA LMs是一项复杂的任务，它涉及基因组学领域特定的挑战和机器学习方法，其中看似微小的实施细节可能会严重损害基准测试的有效性。我们通过BEND（DNA语言模型基准测试）证明了这一点，其中依赖于硬件的超参数——数据加载工作线程数和缓冲区大小——为相同的模型带来了高达4%的虚假性能变化。问题源于不充分的数据混洗与领域特定的数据特征相互作用。对三种DNA语言模型（HyenaDNA、DNABERT-2、ResNet-LM）的实验表明，这些假象影响了绝对性能和相对模型排名。我们提出了一个简单的解决方案：在存储之前预先对数据进行混洗，可以消除硬件依赖性，同时保持效率。这项工作强调了标准的机器学习实践如何与特定领域的数据特征产生意想不到的相互作用，这对专业领域的基准测试设计具有更广泛的影响。
AI.summary: 本文指出，当前DNA语言模型（DNA LMs）的基准测试存在有效性问题，即硬件依赖的超参数（如数据加载设置）与DNA数据特征和不充分的数据混洗相互作用，导致相同模型产生高达4%的虚假性能波动并影响模型排名。通过对HyenaDNA、DNABERT-2和ResNet-LM的实验验证了这一点。作者提出了一种简单的解决方案：在数据存储前进行预混洗，以消除硬件依赖并确保基准测试的可靠性。
AI.keywords: DNA语言模型, 基准测试, 数据混洗, 性能波动, 基因组学
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于揭示了在专业领域（如基因组学）中，看似标准的机器学习操作（如数据加载和混洗）与领域特定数据特征结合时可能产生的严重陷阱。它强调了在设计基准测试时，必须仔细考虑数据预处理和加载过程，以确保结果的可靠性和可复现性。提出预混洗的解决方案简单而有效，对于提高DNA语言模型评估的严谨性具有直接的指导意义。

title: Distributional Shrinkage I: Universal Denoisers in Multi-Dimensions

AI.title_translation: 分布收缩 I：多维通用去噪器
AI.tldr: 针对多维去噪问题，提出了对分布具有普适性的通用去噪器 ($\mathbf{T}_1, \mathbf{T}_2$)。这些去噪器通过最优传输理论，实现了对信号分布 $P_X$ 的更高精度恢复 ($O(\sigma^4), O(\sigma^6)$)，相比Tweedie公式的贝叶斯最优方法有数量级的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 重新审视在多维去噪问题中，仅已知噪声水平 $\sigma$，但信号分布 $P_X$ 和噪声分布 $P_Z$ 均未知的情况。目标是通过去噪从带噪测量分布 $P_Y$ 中恢复潜在的信号分布 $P_X$。
AI.method: 提出并分析了对信号和噪声分布具有普适性的通用分布去噪器（$\mathbf{T}_1$ 和 $\mathbf{T}_2$）。这些去噪器通过最优传输理论，旨在以更高阶精度近似 Monge-Ampère 方程，实现对带噪分布 $P_Y$ 向信号分布 $P_X$ 的最优收缩。该方法可以通过分数匹配（score matching）有效实现。
AI.result: 所提出的分布去噪器在关注整个分布 $P_X$ 而非单个信号实现时，比源自Tweedie公式的贝叶斯最优去噪器提供了数量级的改进。在匹配广义矩和密度函数方面，分别实现了 $O(\sigma^4)$ 和 $O(\sigma^6)$ 的精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并分析了通用分布收缩去噪器（$\mathbf{T}_1$ 和 $\mathbf{T}_2$），它们在仅已知噪声水平的情况下，能够最优地将带噪分布 $P_Y$ 收缩到信号分布 $P_X$。这些去噪器通过更高阶的精度近似 Monge-Ampère 方程，在恢复整个信号分布 $P_X$ 方面，比贝叶斯最优去噪器实现了数量级的性能提升，并在广义矩和密度函数匹配上分别达到 $O(\sigma^4)$ 和 $O(\sigma^6)$ 的精度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了针对多维去噪问题的通用分布收缩去噪器，该去噪器对广泛的信号和噪声分布具有普适性。与传统的贝叶斯最优去噪器相比，这些新公式（如 $\mathbf{T}_1$ 和 $\mathbf{T}_2$）旨在最优地将带噪分布 $P_Y$ 收缩到信号分布 $P_X$，并在匹配广义矩和密度函数上分别达到 $O(\sigma^4)$ 和 $O(\sigma^6)$ 的高阶精度。该方法灵感来源于最优传输理论，通过高阶近似 Monge-Ampère 方程实现，并可通过分数匹配有效实施。
AI.keywords: 分布收缩, 通用去噪器, 最优传输, Monge-Ampère 方程, 分数匹配
AI.comments: 创新点在于提出了对信号和噪声分布具有普适性的通用去噪公式，解决了在缺乏分布信息时进行去噪的问题。该方法通过引入高阶项（如 $\mathbf{T}_2$），显著提高了对信号分布整体恢复的准确性，修正了传统贝叶斯最优去噪器在分布层面上收缩过于激进的问题。其将去噪问题与最优传输理论（Monge-Ampère 方程）和分数匹配相结合，不仅提供了坚实的理论基础，也展现了高效实现的潜力，在多维信号处理和统计推断中具有重要意义。

title: Variational analysis of determinantal varieties
summary: Determinantal varieties -- the sets of bounded-rank matrices or tensors -- have attracted growing interest in low-rank optimization. The tangent cone to low-rank sets is widely studied and underpins a range of geometric methods. The second-order geometry, which encodes curvature information, is more intricate. In this work, we develop a unified framework to derive explicit formulas for both first- and second-order tangent sets to various low-rank sets, including low-rank matrices, tensors, symmetric matrices, and positive semidefinite matrices. The framework also accommodates the intersection of a low-rank set and another set satisfying mild assumptions, thereby yielding a tangent intersection rule. Through the lens of tangent sets, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which a nonsmooth problem and its smooth parameterization share equivalent second-order stationary points. Moreover, we exploit tangent sets to characterize optimality conditions for low-rank optimization and prove that verifying second-order optimality is NP-hard. In a separate line of analysis, we investigate variational geometry of the graph of the normal cone to matrix varieties, deriving the explicit Bouligand tangent cone, Fréchet and Mordukhovich normal cones to the graph. These results are further applied to develop optimality conditions for low-rank bilevel programs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的变分分析框架，用于推导各种低秩集（包括矩阵和张量）的一阶和二阶切集公式，证明了低秩优化的二阶最优性验证是NP难的，并将结果应用于低秩双层规划。
AI.motivation: 低秩优化中，行列式簇（有界秩矩阵或张量集）备受关注。虽然一阶切锥已被广泛研究，但编码曲率信息的二阶几何更为复杂且难以处理。本文旨在提供一个统一框架来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的框架来推导各种低秩集（包括矩阵、张量、对称矩阵、半正定矩阵）的一阶和二阶切集的显式公式。该框架还适用于低秩集与满足温和假设的其他集合的交集，从而得到切集交集规则。此外，还分析了矩阵簇法锥图的变分几何，推导了显式的Bouligand切锥、Fréchet和Mordukhovich法锥。
AI.result: 1. 建立了非光滑问题及其光滑参数化共享等价二阶驻点的充要条件。2. 利用切集刻画了低秩优化的最优性条件。3. 证明了验证低秩优化的二阶最优性是NP难的。4. 结果应用于低秩双层规划的最优性条件开发。
AI.translation: 行列式簇——即有界秩矩阵或张量的集合——在低秩优化中引起了越来越多的关注。低秩集的切锥得到了广泛研究，并支撑了一系列几何方法。然而，编码曲率信息的二阶几何更为复杂。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于推导各种低秩集（包括低秩矩阵、张量、对称矩阵和半正定矩阵）的一阶和二阶切集的显式公式。该框架还适用于低秩集与满足温和假设的其他集合的交集，从而产生切集交集规则。通过切集的视角，我们建立了一个必要且充分的条件，使得非光滑问题及其光滑参数化共享等价的二阶驻点。此外，我们利用切集来刻画低秩优化的最优性条件，并证明了验证二阶最优性是NP难的。在另一条分析思路中，我们研究了矩阵簇法锥图的变分几何，推导了图的显式Bouligand切锥、Fréchet和Mordukhovich法锥。这些结果进一步应用于开发低秩双层规划的最优性条件。
AI.summary: 本文致力于行列式簇（低秩集）的变分分析，开发了一个统一的框架，用于显式推导各种低秩集的一阶和二阶切集，包括低秩矩阵、张量及它们的变体。该框架还涵盖了集合交集的切集规则。通过切集，文章建立了非光滑问题与光滑参数化之间二阶驻点等价的充要条件，刻画了低秩优化的最优性条件，并证明了二阶最优性验证的NP难性。此外，工作还深入研究了矩阵簇法锥图的变分几何，并将结果应用于低秩双层规划。
AI.keywords: 变分分析, 行列式簇, 低秩优化, 二阶几何, 切集
AI.comments: 这项工作具有重要的理论价值，因为它解决了低秩优化中长期存在的挑战——即二阶几何的复杂性。通过提供统一的框架和显式公式，它极大地促进了对低秩集曲率信息的理解。证明二阶最优性验证的NP难度为该领域的计算限制设定了明确的界限。将变分几何应用于法锥图和低秩双层规划，展示了其广泛的应用潜力。

title: Hierarchical Molecular Language Models (HMLMs)
comments: The current version includes minor revisions to the preprint v1 (arXiv preprint arXiv:2512.00696)
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping computational and network biology by enabling new approaches to decode cellular communication networks. We introduce Hierarchical Molecular Language Models (HMLMs), a novel framework that models cellular signaling as a specialized molecular language, where signaling molecules function as tokens, protein interactions define syntax, and functional consequences constitute semantics. HMLMs employ a transformer-based architecture adapted to accommodate graph-structured signaling networks through information transducers, mathematical entities that capture how molecules receive, process, and transmit signals. The architecture integrates multi-modal data sources across molecular, pathway, and cellular scales through hierarchical attention mechanisms and scale-bridging operators that enable information flow across biological hierarchies. Applied to a complex network of cardiac fibroblast signaling, HMLMs outperformed traditional approaches in temporal dynamics prediction, particularly under sparse sampling conditions. Attention-based analysis revealed biologically meaningful crosstalk patterns, including previously uncharacterized interactions between signaling pathways. By bridging molecular mechanisms with cellular phenotypes through AI-driven molecular language representation, HMLMs establish a foundation for biology-oriented large language models (LLMs) that could be pre-trained on comprehensive pathway datasets and applied across diverse signaling systems and tissues, advancing precision medicine and therapeutic discovery.

AI.motivation: 利用人工智能（AI）重塑计算和网络生物学，以解密复杂的细胞通信网络。

AI.result: 应用于心肌成纤维细胞信号网络，HMLMs在时间动态预测方面优于传统方法，尤其在稀疏采样条件下表现突出。基于注意力的分析揭示了具有生物学意义的串扰模式，包括以前未被表征的信号通路间的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: HMLMs通过AI驱动的分子语言表示，建立了连接分子机制与细胞表型的基础，为面向生物学的预训练大型语言模型（LLMs）奠定了基础，有望推动精准医疗和治疗发现。
